jobs.title: Customer Engineer
jobs.description: **About Charta Health** ----------------------- In an industry where the focus should rightly be on delivering quality care to patients, healthcare providers remain burdened by the complexities of non\-clinical operations. Charta is changing that. We're building the operating system for modern healthcare organizations. Our AI platform streamlines critical workflows across revenue cycle, clinical operations, and administrative functions, helping providers and payers operate more efficiently and deliver better patient care. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures, Charta is on a mission to make every healthcare dollar accountable and every chart accurate, reimagining healthcare infrastructure from the ground up. **About the Opportunity** ------------------------- We're looking for a Support Engineer to be the first technical line of defense behind our customer\-facing team. When a client reports that something looks wrong \- a chart that wasn't processed, a code that didn't appear, an integration that stopped sending data, an output that doesn't match what the clinician documented \- you are the person who figures out what actually happened, why, and what it would take to fix it. This is not a customer\-facing role. Our Technical Success Managers own the client relationship and deliver outcomes to customers. You own the investigation behind them: reproducing the issue, tracing it to a root cause in data, logs, configuration, or code, resolving what you can directly, and handing Engineering a well\-scoped diagnosis and proposed fix for what you can't. Your work is what lets our customer team give clients fast, accurate answers \- and what protects our engineers' time for building. Every account is mapped to an owning engineering pod, so you will always know where an escalation goes. You are accountable for the quality of the triage decision and for making sure nothing reaches an engineer that you could have resolved or scoped yourself. **What you'll do:** ------------------- * **Investigate and Diagnose:** Take incoming issues from the Technical Success team \- bugs, data discrepancies, processing gaps, unexpected model output \- and dig in hands\-on. Reproduce the problem, query the data, read logs and pipeline runs, and trace the issue to a root cause. * **Triage with Judgment:** Classify every issue quickly and correctly: live incident vs. one\-off, deployment/configuration issue vs. product bug vs. expected behavior vs. feature gap. Route incidents to oncall, bugs and gaps to the owning pod, and close out anything that is working as designed \- with the evidence to show it. * **Resolve What You Can (Tier 1\):** Fix configuration, mapping, and data issues directly; re\-run failed jobs; correct customer\-specific setup; and answer "did Charta do this?" questions with a definitive, evidence\-backed yes or no. * **Propose Fixes (Tier 2\):** For code\-level defects, go beyond "it's broken." Identify where in the codebase the problem lives, write up the root cause, and propose a fix \- up to and including drafting the change for engineering review. Engineers should receive a ticket they can act on, not a mystery. * **Hand Off Cleanly to the Customer Team:** Give the Technical Success Manager a clear, plain\-English summary of what happened, what was affected, what's being done, and a realistic timeline \- so they can deliver the message to the client with confidence. * **Own the Loop Internally:** Track every open issue from intake to resolution. Follow up with Engineering, confirm fixes in production, and tell the customer team when it's safe to close the loop with the client. * **Build the Knowledge Base:** Turn every investigation into reusable knowledge \- runbooks, known\-issue write\-ups, diagnostic queries, and triage guides \- so the same question takes minutes, not hours, the next time, and so the customer team can self\-serve more over time. * **Spot Patterns:** Aggregate issues across accounts to surface recurring defects, fragile integrations, and gaps in monitoring or tooling. Bring data\-driven recommendations to Product and Engineering about what to fix at the source. **You'd be a great fit, if you:** --------------------------------- * **Are Technically Strong.** You are comfortable reading code (Python and/or TypeScript), writing SQL, working through logs and data pipelines, and using AI coding tools to move quickly through an unfamiliar codebase. You can work alongside engineers as a peer. * **Are a Relentless Debugger.** When something doesn't add up, your instinct is to dig until you find the real cause \- not the first plausible one. You rule out the obvious (Is there a live incident? Was there a recent deploy? Is this reproducible?) before you escalate. * **Figure It Out Yourself.** This role runs on documentation, tooling, and your own initiative. You are self\-sufficient in the weeds and come back with answers, not questions. * **Write Excellent Tickets.** Your escalations are clear, reproducible, and scoped: what happened, the evidence, the suspected cause, the blast radius, and a proposed fix. Engineers are glad to receive them. * **Translate Technical to Plain English.** You can explain a root cause to an engineer in one message and to a non\-technical teammate in the next. * **Prioritize Under Pressure.** You can hold several open investigations at once, tell urgent from important, and keep everyone informed on status. * **Handle Sensitive Data Responsibly.** You understand that healthcare data demands care, and you follow access and privacy practices without shortcuts. * **Have experience** in technical support engineering, support/escalation engineering, solutions engineering, SRE/production support, or software engineering \- preferably in B2B SaaS, where you worked directly in a production codebase and data. **Nice to have:** ----------------- * Experience in healthcare technology, especially EHR/EMR integrations (HL7, FHIR, or vendor APIs), medical coding, or risk adjustment. * Experience supporting data pipelines, workflow orchestration, or ETL systems. * Experience debugging LLM\- or ML\-driven products, including evaluating model output and prompt behavior. * Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS), observability tools, and ticketing/issue\-tracking workflows. * Experience building internal tools, scripts, or dashboards that made a support team faster. **What we offer:** ------------------ * Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, vision, and life insurance. * Team dinners and snacks in the office to keep you at your best. * Growth opportunities in a fast\-paced, innovative tech startup. * Ongoing professional development and access to cutting\-edge AI and healthcare tools. * $90,000\- $150,000 depending on experience \+ Equity \+ Benefits. **Our Commitment to Diversity** ------------------------------- We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.description: *Survey Crew Chief \- Twin Cities* **Company Overview** Civil Site Group is a professional civil engineering, landscape architecture, land surveying and land planning company located in Golden Valley, MN. We provide professional consulting services to the real estate, development, financial and municipal community throughout the Minneapolis/St. Paul Metro and surrounding area. We are seeking a self\-starter, team\-oriented individual that wants to advance their survey career with a highly skilled and notable company. A qualified candidate for this position will be able to develop their career with diverse survey experience on boundary, topographic, ALTA, platting and construction staking projects. Opportunities for professional development and continued education are fully encouraged and financially supported on a company\-wide basis. We have a group with diverse skillsets and backgrounds and are looking to add someone who is eager to learn and grow within our company. **Company Benefits:** Civil Site Group is conveniently located within ten minutes of downtown Minneapolis. At Civil Site Group, we’re focused on working hard and delivering results to our customers, but in the meantime, we take care of our employees. We have a laid\-back office environment and start\-up culture, where employees are rewarded for their ideas and service. We're a profit\-sharing company, offering industry leading 401(k) bonuses to full\-time employees. We offer comprehensive medical and dental plans with HSA options, company paid life insurance, and short\-long term disability insurance. We can accommodate those seeking a 40\-Hour work week and those that want to rack up OT hours. We offer 10 company paid holidays and 15 Paid Vacation days per year as well as cash bonuses during the first year of employment. **Department:** Land Surveying **Reports To:** Director of Land Surveying / Survey Department Manager **Employment Status:** Full\-Time, Non\-Exempt **Typical Schedule:** Monday through Friday, with early\-morning start times generally between 7:00 and 7:30 a.m. Hours may vary based on project needs, weather, travel, and daylight conditions. **Position Summary** The Survey Crew Chief leads field surveying activities for a variety of residential, commercial, industrial, municipal, and land development projects. This position is responsible for planning and completing accurate field surveys, operating survey equipment, maintaining clear field records, and directing the work of survey technicians and other field crew members. The Survey Crew Chief works closely with Professional Land Surveyors, civil engineers, project managers, contractors, clients, and property owners. The successful candidate will be dependable, safety\-conscious, technically capable, and comfortable working independently in changing outdoor conditions. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Lead a one\- or two\-person survey crew and coordinate daily field assignments. * Review project information, construction plans, plats, legal descriptions, control data, and survey instructions before beginning fieldwork. * Perform boundary, topographic, ALTA/NSPS, construction staking, as\-built, utility, right\-of\-way, easement, and subdivision surveys. * Establish and verify horizontal and vertical survey control. * Locate property corners, monuments, improvements, utilities, site features, and existing conditions. * Complete construction staking for buildings, utilities, grading, curb and gutter, roadways, parking lots, and other site improvements. * Operate robotic total stations, GPS/GNSS equipment, data collectors, digital levels, and related surveying equipment. * Maintain accurate, organized, and complete field notes, electronic data, photographs, sketches, and daily records. * Download, upload, organize, and perform preliminary review of survey data. * Perform field calculations and identify discrepancies or missing information before leaving the project site. * Communicate field conditions, conflicts, access issues, safety concerns, and potential project changes to the appropriate project manager or Professional Land Surveyor. * Direct, train, and support survey technicians and other crew members. * Confirm that fieldwork is performed efficiently and in accordance with company procedures, project requirements, and applicable surveying standards. * Maintain survey vehicles, equipment, tools, supplies, and assigned safety equipment. * Follow company safety policies and use appropriate traffic control and personal protective equipment. * Interact professionally with clients, contractors, public agencies, property owners, and members of the public. * Travel to project locations throughout the Twin Cities metropolitan area and, occasionally, other areas of Minnesota and Wisconsin. * Perform other surveying and project\-related duties as assigned. **Required Qualifications** * High school diploma or equivalent. * At least three years of land surveying field e cal Requirements** This position regularly requires the employee to: * Stand and walk for extended periods over uneven, steep, muddy, snowy, wooded, or construction\-site terrain. * Frequently bend, kneel, crouch, climb, reach, and maintain balance. * Carry survey equipment, stakes, supplies, and other materials across project sites. * Regularly lift and carry up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift or move up to 70 pounds with appropriate assistance or equipment. * Use hand tools, including hammers, shovels, digging tools, and measuring devices. * Enter and exit survey vehicles frequently throughout the workday. * Work near active construction equipment, roadways, traffic, excavations, water, vegetation, insects, and other outdoor hazards. * Perform work in heat, cold, rain, snow, wind, humidity, dust, and direct sunlight. **Work Environment** Most duties are performed outdoors at construction sites, developed properties, roadways, vacant land, wooded areas, and other project locations. Some office work may be required for reviewing plans, processing field data, maintaining equipment, attending meetings, or coordinating assignments. Work hours may vary depending on weather, travel, construction schedules, project deadlines, and seasonal workload. Occasional overtime may be required. Performance Expectations The Survey Crew Chief is expected to: * Produce accurate and complete fieldwork. * Arrive on time and prepared for each assignment. * Protect company equipment and property. * Complete assignments within established schedules and budgets. * Communicate issues promptly rather than allowing field questions to remain unresolved. * Maintain a professional and respectful attitude with coworkers, clients, contractors, and the public. * Promote a safe, efficient, and positive work environment. * Support the development and training of less\-experienced survey staff. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Civil Site Group, PC is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, pregnancy, marital status, familial status, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employees assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of every responsibility, duty, qualification, or working condition associated with the position. Responsibilities may be modified based on business and project needs. **Benefit Conditions:** * Waiting period may apply * Only full\-time employees eligible **This Job Is:** * A job for which military experienced candidates are encouraged to apply * Open to applicants under 18 years old, provided it is legally allowed for the job and location **Work Remotely** * No **Non\-Solicitation Notice to Recruitment Agencies:** Civil Site Group requests that recruitment agencies and third\-party recruiters do not submit unsolicited resumes or candidate information to any Civil Site Group employee or office. If recruitment services are required, we will reach out directly to agencies on our approved vendor list. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $34\.00 \- $42\.00 per hour Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Professional development assistance * Referral program * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Compensation Package: * Bonus opportunities Physical Setting: * Construction site * Outdoor work Education: * High school or equivalent (Required) Experience: * Land Surveying: 3 years (Preferred) * Survey Crew Chief: 3 years (Preferred) License/Certification: * Driver's License (Required) Work Location: In person

Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder. Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items, and today we employ more than 3,000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, and France. We're transforming the collecting experience with technology that brings authentication, grading, and trading into the modern era. Our products are equalizing the playing field by providing tools that make complex research analytics — including pricing, scarcity reports, and historic sales data — accessible to every collector, old or new. Our Product \& Engineering mission is to democratize technology while promoting innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning throughout the organization. **About the Role** ------------------ We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build the PSA Liquidity Platform — the product suite that connects supply and demand across our marketplace, including PSA Partner Offers and our eBay Consignment platform. PSA Partner Offers is a first\-party marketplace that sources offers from our network of buyers and surfaces them as instant, targeted offers to grading and vault customers. Our eBay consignment business allows customers to seamlessly sell on the world's largest marketplace while we handle every step of fulfillment as eBay's official vault partner. You'll own the technical design and delivery of the end\-to\-end buyer and seller experiences, partnering with a dedicated cross\-functional team (business, product, engineering, design, data) to seamlessly connect supply and demand. This is a high\-visibility, high\-impact role on our Marketplace engineering team, building systems that maximize GMV, conversion, and offer\-to\-sale velocity at scale. We believe there is significant value in onsite partnership and team collaboration, and candidates within 1\-hour commuting distance of the office may be expected to work onsite most of the time. Additional details will be discussed during the recruiting process. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Build powerful buyer tooling.** Lead development of our next\-generation buyer platform: targeting, campaign management, budget controls, and analytics that let every type of buyer — from individual collectors to large\-scale dealers — discover and acquire the right cards at scale. * **Build and optimize the offer pricing engine.** Partner with Engineering and AI/ML to build a sophisticated, real\-time targeting and ranking engine that maximizes marketplace GMV, conversion, and offer\-to\-sale velocity across channels. * **Elevate the seller experience.** Make it effortless for sellers to understand their options, price their items accurately, and complete a sale via the PSA Partner Offer or eBay Consignment channel with Translate strategy into clear technical plans, specs, and user stories. Coordinate delivery across dedicated and partner engineering teams, and keep stakeholders aligned and projects moving. * **Connect the ecosystem.** Ensure seamless liquidity handoffs across the broader PSA enterprise, from Grading to Collection Management to Vaulting, reducing friction and resolving cross\-system dependencies that span payments, logistics, and risk. * **Communicate with clarity at every level.** From executive reviews to engineering standups, synthesize complexity, articulate tradeoffs, and bring people with you — clearly, in writing and in person. **Who You Are** --------------- * **6\+ years engineering experience.** You have a track record of designing, shipping, and scaling products 0\-to\-1 that have measurable business impact. Ideally 2\+ years operating as a Senior IC or equivalent technical leadership level at a high\-growth company or a scaled consumer platform. * **Full\-stack range.** You have strong proficiency in Java (Spring Boot) and equally comfortable in modern frontend frameworks like React and Svelte, moving fluidly across the stack. Mobile experience using Flutter/Dart is a plus. * **Distributed\-systems depth.** You've designed and operated microservices and Kafka\-based event\-driven architectures, run workloads on Kubernetes, and know your way around the AWS ecosystem. * **Observability\-first mindset.** You instrument what you ship using tools such as Datadog, New Relic, or OpenTelemetry. You're comfortable building dashboards, setting up monitoring/alerting, and using distributed tracing to debug production issues. * **AI\-first engineer.** You build with AI tooling across the SDLC \- from planning and code generation to review and debugging. You lean on your experience to make high\-conviction calls quickly. * **Systems thinker and customer focused.** You naturally decompose complex, multi\-service systems into clean boundaries and intuitive interfaces, without losing sight of the customer experience. * **Influential communicator.** A strong written and verbal communicator who aligns engineers, product partners, and stakeholders without direct authority, makes crisp calls, and brings people with you. * **Bias for ownership.** You have an extreme ownership mindset and will wear any hat required to get the job done. You thrive in a fast\-moving, self\-directed environment — you set the bar, hold it, and take full accountability for outcomes. * **Passion for collecting** is a plus. Collectors uses e\-Verify to validate your ability to work legally in the United States. We are aware that there are instances where individuals are receiving job offers that fraudulently allege to be from Collectors or one of our business units. This type of fraud can be carried out through false websites, through fake e\-mails claiming to be from the company or through social media. We never ask for personal information such as your bank account, Social Security numbers or National IDs, nor do we send or request payments for the purchase of business\-related equipment. If you suspect fraud, please reach out to interviewfraud@collectors.com. *We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or other class protected by applicable law. We believe that a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills will better service the diverse community of collectors we support.* *If you require an accommodation to apply or interview with us due to a disability or special need, please email* *interviewaccommodation@collectors.com* *U.S. residents: for disclosures relating to personal information we collect during the employment application and recruitment process, please see our* *Privacy Notice for U.S. Applicants* *.*

jobs.title: Instrumentation / Electrical Technician II - Wastewater
jobs.description: **Job Summary** --------------- Collier County strives to be an employer of choice, and many of our employees build long\-term careers with us. The salary listed in the job description reflects the full pay range for this position, from entry level through advanced career stages. **NEW EMPLOYEES ARE HIRED AT, OR NEAR THE ENTRY POINT SHOWN, DEPENDING ON QUALIFICATIONS AND RELEVANT EXPERIENCE.** Programs and maintains electrical controls, instrumentation, and equipment associated with water/wastewater operations. Maintains the integrity and safety of the extensive electrical, telemetry and instrumentation equipment related to the wastewater divisions. Oversees the installation of new telemetry equipment. Performs various tasks involving maintenance of utility systems, equipment, and facilities in wastewater. **Essential Functions** ----------------------- • Supervises, directs, and evaluates assigned staff, processing employee concerns and problems, directing work, counseling, disciplining, and completing employee performance appraisals. • Conducts on\-site safety, equipment, and electrical training for new and current employees; trains staff in operations of new facilities. • Coordinates daily work activities; organizes, prioritizes, and assigns work; monitors status of work in progress and inspects completed work; confers with assigned staff, assists with complex/problem situations, and provides technical expertise. • Ensures compliance with all applicable codes, laws, rules, regulations, standards, policies, and procedures; ensures adherence to established safety procedures; monitors work environment and use of safety equipment to ensure safety of employees and other individuals; initiates any actions necessary to correct deviations or violations; reviews and updates standards for water/wastewater, instrumentation, telemetry, and electrical equipment. • Develops and updates training manuals and procedure manuals for instrumentation and telemetry equipment; provides division with SCADA network information and training. • Performs specialized electrical work associated with installation, programming, and repair of equipment/machinery at water/wastewater facilities, off\-site operations, and related facilities. • Installs, programs, calibrates, and/or repairs a variety of instrumentation and electronic equipment, which may include variable frequency drives, flow meters, transducers, generators, transfer switches, programmable logic controls, integrated controls, motor control panels, electrical services, branch circuits, sub\-feeders, lift station panels, data flow systems, SCADA. or antennas. • Operates central telemetry computer to program, monitor, and control stations and facilities; troubleshoots telemetry computer problems; troubleshoots stations and facilities; programs lift station configuration; designs and builds electrical controls; builds screens and control logic; generates trend data and reports; modifies configuration of external hardware; calculates electrical loads and hydraulics on lift stations. • Reviews, oversees, and inspects all projects with electrical controls; inspects new facilities to ensure compliance with codes and regulations. • Assesses systems of other municipalities to set guidelines for Collier County. • Performs installation, maintenance, and repair of electrical/electronic equipment and mechanical equipment; builds, installs, and repairs equipment; repairs motors and meters; troubleshoots flow/plumbing problems; installs drive parts; installs and repairs pumps; welds parts and fabricates metal components; wires control panels; repairs electrical/electronic equipment; performs preventive maintenance work according to schedule; assists with trenching for installation and repair of conduits; assists in installing pump cords and floats. • Provides installation, repair and troubleshooting of SCADA network components, radio telemetry systems, programmable logic controllers, microcomputer workstations, voice telephone switches and other systems; troubleshoots and corrects major system failures involving instrumentation and telemetry equipment; troubleshoots and modifies computer programs for programmable logic controllers and graphical interface software; supervises and monitors installation and repair work performed by contracted service providers. • Assists in developing and implementing long and short\-term plans, goals, and objectives; evaluates efficiency and effectiveness of operations, methods, procedures, and use of resources; implements improvements as needed. • Provides input and recommendations to management, project managers, and consultants regarding upgrades to the SCADA system and the telemetry system and other capital projects; evaluates vendor proposals and recommends selection; ensures that the current equipment will integrate with newly installed equipment. • Recommends budgets and staffing needs to management. • Operates various equipment and tools associated with work activities, which may include a utility truck, boom truck, generator, hydraulic punch, drill machine, welder, drill, pickax, post hole digger, shovel, mechanic tools, electrical tools, diagnostic instruments, or hand tools. • Performs general/preventive maintenance tasks necessary to keep vehicles, building, equipment, and tools in operable condition; monitors equipment operations to maintain efficiency and safety; reports faulty equipment. • Monitors inventory levels of equipment, tools, parts, and supplies; ensures availability of adequate materials to conduct work activities; initiates requests for new/replacement materials. • Follows safety procedures, utilizes safety equipment, and monitors work environment to ensure safety of employees and other individuals. • Communicates with supervisor, employees, other Divisions, engineers, contractors, utility companies, vendors, the public, and other individuals as needed to coordinate work activities, review status of work, exchange information, or resolve problems. • Maintains an awareness of new technologies, methods, trends, and advances in the profession; reads professional literature; maintains professional affiliations; attends workshops and training sessions as appropriate; maintains a network of SCADA professionals. • Operates a motor vehicle, programmable controllers, telemetric radios, electrical testing devices, instrument calibration devices, office equipment and other equipment to complete essential functions; operates a computer to program information and to enter, retrieve, review or modify data; utilizes word processing, spreadsheet, control system, telemetry system, diagnostics, or other computer programs. ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONS Performs other related duties as required. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- • High school diploma or GED required. • Five (5\) years previous experience and/or training in related field is required. • Fingerprinting required. LICENSES/CERTIFICATES • A valid Journeyman Electricians License, Masters License, or applicable instrumentation license or certification is preferred. • Must possess and maintain a valid Florida Driver's License with any applicable endorsement(s) to drive a County vehicle as provided in CMA 5805\. Must obtain and maintain a Class C Wastewater license within eighteen (18\) months of employment. **Supplemental information** ---------------------------- * Salary offers above the minimum pay grade may be considered based on qualifications. * Essential Employees may be required to work during an undeclared or declared emergency. The County’s Administrative Office will determine who will be required to work on an incident\-by\-incident basis. * This job posting is not intended to be an all\-inclusive list of responsibilities, skills, or working conditions associated with the position.

jobs.title: AI Engineer – Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Test Company Description **Job Description** About the Role We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer – AI Engineer** to design, build, and productionize AI\-powered solutions that solve real\-world business and customer problems. Technical Skills **Programming:** Python, Java, SQL **AI/ML:** Machine Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, NLP, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering, model evaluation **AI Frameworks:** LangChain, LlamaIndex, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent **Backend:** REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems **Cloud:** AWS / Azure / Google Cloud **Databases:** SQL and NoSQL databases, vector databases **DevOps:** Git, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, monitoring and observability What You'll Bring * Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills. * Ability to turn ambiguous problems into practical technical solutions. * Strong ownership and ability to drive projects from concept to production. * A product\-oriented mindset with a focus on measurable outcomes. * Ability to balance experimentation with production\-quality engineering. * Strong communication and collaboration skills. * Curiosity and willingness to continuously learn and experiment with emerging AI technologies. Role Details **Job Title:** Senior Software Engineer – AI Engineer **Experience:** 5\+ years **Employment Type:** Full\-time **Department:** Engineering / Artificial Intelligence **Qualifications** Required Qualifications * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. * **5\+ years of professional software engineering experience**, with experience building and deploying production systems. * Strong programming skills in **Python and/or Java**. * Strong understanding of software engineering principles, object\-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and system design. * Hands\-on experience with **Generative AI, LLMs, or machine learning systems**. * Experience working with APIs and integrating AI/ML models into applications. * Experience with cloud platforms such as **AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud**. * Experience with databases and data processing systems. * Strong understanding of testing, debugging, CI/CD, version control, and production operations. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with **OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or other foundation models**. * Experience building **RAG\-based applications** using embeddings and vector databases. * Experience with vector databases such as **Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, OpenSearch, or pgvector**. * Experience with frameworks such as **LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Semantic Kernel**. * Experience developing AI agents and tool\-using LLM applications. * Experience with ML frameworks such as **PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit\-learn**. * Experience with model evaluation, fine\-tuning, or parameter\-efficient fine\-tuning. * Familiarity with **MLOps/LLMOps** practices. * Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud\-native application development. * Knowledge of AI security, data privacy, responsible AI, and model safety practices. * Experience designing highly scalable distributed systems. **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Mechanical Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature\-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best\-in\-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category\-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next\-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead. Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today! **Job Description:** ==================== The Systems Engineer works as part of a multi\-disciplinary team to undertake custom industrial refrigeration and gas compression system equipment design \- performing calculations, making component selections, and building documentation for our customers according to requirements of their project. The engineer supports the delivery of project related engineering results and is responsible for the work they're assigned by the Project Engineer. Success in this position requires the candidate to work efficiently in both a collaborative and independent environment, be safety conscious, have good interpersonal skills with both internal and external customers, pay high attention to details, and have a strong motivation for delivering objectives. **As A Systems Engineer, You Will:** ==================================== * Review and interpret codes and standards (ASME, CRN, NFPA, AWS, IBC, etc.) for system compliance. * Make system component selections while generating a project Piping and Instrumentation Diagram (P\&ID). Confer with Mechanical Design Engineers on standard products included in the project. * Conduct all necessary calculations, design reviews with production, and develop all custom documentation required for project execution. * Review and approve production drawings for custom systems, adding recommendations to improve design, reduce costs, or increase production efficiency. Chip in as a technical resource to the shop, customers, sales, and other departments to address and resolve questions and problems. * Prepare specifications for custom equipment and work with procurement to obtain quotations. * Participate in multi\-functional teams to address new design issues and resolve problems to ensure the continuous, ongoing improvement of processes and methods. **Required Education, Experience and Skills:** ============================================== * Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or other relevant field with 1\+ years of engineering experience. Ability to understand and address a wide variety of technical problems with little mentorship. * Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and concisely in writing and other presentation formats. Working experience with AutoCAD or similar 2D CAD software. * Must be an outstanding teammate, willing to learn from experienced staff and capable of introducing positive changes. Ability to travel 5\-10%. * Legal work authorization in the United States \- Sponsorship will not be provided for this role **Preferred Education, Experience \& Skills:** ============================================== * Previous experience with Compression systems or other pressure piping systems. Experience with Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P\&ID). * Understanding of manufacturing BOM structure and ERP. * Previous experience in heat transfer products or thermodynamic systems. * Ability to coordinate and lead teams with varied strengths to implement changes and improvements. \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-KC2 **Our Commitment to Our People** Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal \- to make the world a better place. We invest in the end\-to\-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally. Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs: medical insurance plans, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) and more. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave, vacation and holiday leave. Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team! **Our Commitment to Inclusion \& Belonging** At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland. **Work Authorization** Copeland will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. jobs.title: Senior IT Systems Engineer
jobs.description: This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced IT professional to oversee critical infrastructure engineering and deployment within the County of Santa Barbara’s Information Technology Department. Come and be a part of a team of talented individuals who are passionate about fostering a **culture of teamwork, learning and respect**! In the IT Department our success is powered by people and technology. Our culture is what makes IT a fun and rewarding place to work! We establish, develop and nurture partnerships and open communication within our communities. We embrace a willingness to learn and accept new ideas, to actively listen and to be receptive to change. We strive to grow our talents and do our best in the service of others while taking pride in our work. We explore and deliver new and creative ways to pair technology with business needs **The Service Operations Division** The Service Operations Division keeps the County’s technology foundation strong, secure, and always available. We organize our work around a proven operating model: Design, Build, Run. The systems we deliver are thoughtfully architected, expertly engineered, and reliably operated: * **Design \-** Our Systems Architect drives architecture, strategy, and modernization, setting the technical direction so that solutions are built to last. * **Build \-** Our engineering and deployment team turns approved designs into secure, production\-ready systems, the engineering, deployment, and delivery that bring modernization to life. * **Run \-** Our Infrastructure Operations team sustains what we deliver, providing the reliable, secure, and resilient operations the County depends on day in and day out. The Senior IT Systems Engineer sits at the heart of the **Build** function, translating architectural vision into the dependable infrastructure that County departments, and the communities they serve, rely on every day. **The Position** The Senior IT Systems Engineer is responsible for the engineering, implementation, and delivery of the County’s enterprise technology infrastructure. This role participates in the Build function within the Service Operations division and is responsible for translating approved architectural designs into secure, reliable, and supportable production systems. This role works on engineering and deployment activities across core infrastructure platforms including identity and directory services, Microsoft 365 services, endpoint and client computing environments, on\-premises and cloud server infrastructure, storage systems, backup and disaster recovery solutions, and Azure cloud services. The Senior IT Systems Engineer ensures solutions are implemented in alignment with architectural standards, cybersecurity requirements, and operational readiness expectations prior to transition to ongoing support. With guidance from the Engineering and Deployment Supervisor, this role partners closely with the Systems Architect (Design), Infrastructure Operations (Run), network and cybersecurity staff, application teams, vendors, and department stakeholders to deliver enterprise initiatives and modernization efforts on schedule and with high quality. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Site Reliability Engineering
jobs.description: Overview: **Our Culture and Impact** Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500\+ employees and \~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection. Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections. **AI at Cvent: Leading the Future** Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation. Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you. Cvent's site reliability organization is seeking a hands\-on technical manager to lead a globally distributed "Product SRE" team. The platform runs more than 8 million events per year, including live gatherings with over 50,000 attendees. Your team will operate cloud\-native infrastructure, build reliability tooling and AI agents, accelerate software delivery for product development teams, and lead the technical onboarding of newly acquired companies. You will run towards the fire, write code alongside your team, raise the bar, and build a team that does the same. In This Role, You Will:: * Set the strategy for your team and help shape the overall SRE program for the company * Build partnerships with engineering and platform teams around reliability standards and shared practices * Champion a culture of excellence in site reliability and automation * Lead and technically mentor a team of SREs, writing code, reviewing pull requests, and pairing on hard problems alongside them * Directly manage a team of 5–10 SREs: set clear expectations, run 1:1s, build individualized growth plans, deliver candid feedback, and own hiring and performance decisions * Own the reliability, security posture, and cloud cost efficiency of the infrastructure your team operates * Be on call as the team's escalation point and Incident Commander * Enable partner engineering teams to continuously improve software delivery and developer experience * Partner with product teams to evaluate and strengthen SLI/SLO definitions, translating each product's reliability needs into objectives that are achievable and meaningful * Lead the technical onboarding of acquired companies, integrating their infrastructure, teams, and systems onto Cvent's platform and reliability standards * Foster a culture of learning and technical ownership across the team and its engineering partners * Design, build, and own AI agents and reliability tooling with dedicated budget * Apply AI to your own management work: use it to accelerate QBR prep, KTLO analysis, and routine reporting * Drive AI adoption across the team's full SDLC, from planning and code review to incident response and postmortems Here's What You Need:: * 5\+ years of experience managing technology professionals * 10\+ years of overall technology experience * Proven experience running large\-scale distributed systems in AWS, including container orchestration (ECS, EKS, Kubernetes); familiarity with Azure or multi\-cloud architecture a plus * Deep command of SRE principles and modern platform engineering practices * Excellence in technical team leadership, with a history of developing engineers through pairing, code review, and hands\-on mentorship * Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure as Code at production scale (AWS CDK preferred; Python, Go, or equivalent welcome); this is a working technical role, not a purely managerial one * Experience managing roadmaps and resource allocations *This job posting is intended to comply with all applicable laws. jobs.description: **D\-Wave Quantum Inc. (NASDAQ: QBTS)** is a leader in the development and delivery of quantum computing systems, software, and services. It is the world’s first commercial supplier of quantum computers, and the first and only to offer dual\-platform quantum computing products and services, spanning both annealing and gate\-model quantum computing technologies. D\-Wave’s mission is to help customers realize the value of quantum today through enterprise\-grade systems available on\-premises and via its Leap™ quantum cloud service, which offers 99\.9% availability and uptime. jobs.description: ### **Role Description \& Responsibilities** Our Dassault Systèmes R\&D Quality Engineering team is excited to announce a hybrid internship opportunity based out of our **Pleasanton, CA Dassault Systèmes office**. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff. * **Effective Communication and Influence:** Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well\-structured arguments and trade\-offs supported by evidence. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence. **The successful candidate will possess:** * Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care. **Required Qualifications:** * A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor. * 6\+ years of full\-stack software engineering experience with most of the following: JavaScript/TypeScript, Angular, React, NodeJS, Python, SQL/NoSQL, REST/API integrations, ServiceNow application development and deployment patterns, LangChain, LangGraph, as well as unit and integration testing frameworks. * 3\+ years of experience building AI/ML and agentic applications, with hands\-on GenAI experience across LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open\-source models), RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector databases, evaluations, and AI agent orchestration, and applied AI capabilities on platforms such as ServiceNow. * 3\+ years of experience with cloud\-native engineering, using FaaS, PaaS, micro\-services, or enterprise platform deployment models, including Azure, AWS, GCP, including their AI/ML services such as ServiceNow NowAssist plus application\-level infrastructure\-as\-code, and cost\-aware engineering (FinOps accountability) * 1\+ years of experience in establishing engineering standards, including actively leading, mentoring, and guiding team members in the adoption and continuous improvement of these standards. * Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI\-augmented spec\-driven development. * Prior experience using methodologies \& tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, Automated Test Framework (ATF), MLflow, and agentic AI frameworks (e.g. ServiceNow NASK, MCP, LangFuse, LangSmith, or equivalent multi\-agent orchestration tools) etc. to deliver high\-quality products rapidly. * ServiceNow engineering experience, including platform architecture, workflow automation, integrations, and AI\-enabled ServiceNow capabilities, with the ability to translate product needs into scalable enterprise solutions. * Preferred certifications may include ServiceNow Certified System Administrator, Certified Application Developer, CIS\-HRSD, CIS\-Data Foundations, CIS\-ITSM, CIS\-IRM, CIS\-SPM, AI/GenAI\-focused ServiceNow credentials, or relevant cloud/AI certifications. * Candidates must be located within a commutable distance to the select location available for this role * Ability to work in your local office at a minimum of 3 days per week **Other:** * Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build. * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. jobs.title: Manager, SEO & AI Discovery
jobs.description: **Job Description:** As a Manager, SEO \& AI Discovery at Merkle, you will lead SEO strategy across a portfolio of client accounts, setting program direction, owning complex audits and recommendations, and translating search performance into business outcomes. This role is built for a senior individual contributor who can move comfortably between technical SEO, content and on\-page strategy, AI\-driven discovery, performance measurement, and client advisory. You will serve as a trusted lead for assigned accounts, helping clients understand what is happening, why it matters, and what to do next. **Core Responsibilities** * **Lead SEO strategy across assigned accounts:** Set search program direction, prioritize workstreams, and ensure recommendations connect to client business goals, marketing priorities, and measurable outcomes. * **Serve as the day\-to\-day search lead:** Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders, understand their goals, KPIs, business context, priorities, and decision\-making dynamics, and translate search priorities into clear, business\-relevant action. * **Own complex SEO / AI audits and analyses:** Independently diagnose performance opportunities across technical SEO, content and on\-page optimization, AI Search visibility, competitive landscape, and site architecture. * **Develop measurement frameworks:** Define SEO reporting structures that connect organic visibility, technical health, content performance, classic SERP visibility, AI Overview presence, LLM visibility, and business outcomes. * **Turn data into decisions:** Analyze data from GSC, GA4, crawl tools, rank tracking, log files, AI visibility platforms, and third\-party tools to identify patterns, explain performance shifts, and prioritize action. * **Create actionable recommendations:** Translate findings into prioritized recommendations with clear impact, effort, dependencies, confidence level, and implementation guidance for client, content, and engineering teams. * **Lead technical SEO workstreams:** Guide recommendations across crawl, indexation, rendering, JavaScript SEO, Core Web Vitals, site architecture, internal linking, schema, structured data, migrations, and re\-platforming. * **Advance content and AI Search visibility:** Lead search intent mapping, topical authority planning, SERP feature analysis, AI Overview evaluation, LLM visibility analysis, entity and brand authority recommendations, and scalable on\-page optimization frameworks. * **Own delivery quality:** Manage assigned SEO workstreams end\-to\-end, including scoping, work planning, QA, stakeholder updates, timeline management, and on\-time delivery. * **Mentor and review junior work:** Coach consultants and staff consultants on analysis planning, data interpretation, recommendation quality, deliverable structure, and client\-ready communication. * **Support account growth:** Identify organic growth opportunities, contribute SEO expertise to pitches, RFPs, renewals, and SOW scoping, and help shape work that is clearly scoped, valuable to clients, and feasible for the team to deliver. * **Improve the SEO practice:** Contribute to internal templates, playbooks, QA standards, training materials, AI\-assisted workflows, and process improvements that help the team deliver better work at scale. **What You’ll Bring** * 3\+ years of progressive SEO experience, preferably in an agency, consultancy, or complex multi\-stakeholder environment. * Strong technical SEO capability across crawl, indexation, rendering, site architecture, internal linking, Core Web Vitals, structured data, migrations, and JavaScript SEO. * Demonstrated capability in SEO analysis and measurement, including the ability to combine multiple data sources and translate findings into business\-relevant recommendations. * Hands\-on experience with tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog, Sitebulb, Ahrefs, SEMRush, enterprise crawlers, rank tracking platforms, Data Studio, and AI visibility tracking platforms. * Ability to build clear, persuasive client deliverables, including audits, executive summaries, dashboards, roadmaps, and strategic recommendation decks. * Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to adjust communication for executives, marketers, engineers, content teams, and internal stakeholders. * Experience leading client conversations, answering questions in real time, and explaining and supporting recommendations with evidence, context, and judgment. * Working knowledge of AI Search, including AI Overviews, LLM\-powered discovery, citation visibility, entity authority, and AI\-assisted SEO workflows. * Strong project and workstream ownership, including the ability to manage timelines, flag risks early, coordinate with PMs and cross\-functional teams, and keep stakeholders informed. * Comfort mentoring consultants and staff consultants and reviewing their work for analytical accuracy, strategic clarity, and client readiness. **Preferred / Bonus Experience** * BigQuery, SQL, Python, server log analysis, API\-based reporting, or other scalable data workflows. * Experience with international SEO, e\-commerce SEO, local SEO, video/image SEO, link building, digital PR, or SEO testing. * Experience developing reusable SEO templates, processes, playbooks, training materials, or productized service offerings. **Leadership \& Ways of Working** * You are proactive, responsive, and self\-directed. You readily provide status/account updates, risks, or next steps. * You can manage multiple accounts or workstreams at once without losing quality, context, or follow\-through. * You are comfortable with ambiguity and can turn broad client questions into structured analysis plans and practical recommendations. * You raise risks early, propose paths forward, and balance client needs with team capacity and scope boundaries. * You help make the team better by sharing what you know, improving how work gets done, and creating space for consultants and staff consultants to grow. The annual salary range for this position is 65K\- 75K. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law. Benefits available with this position include: Medical, vision, and dental insurance, Life insurance, Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, 401k, Flexible paid time off, At least 15 paid holidays per year, Paid sick and safe leave, and Paid parental leave. Dentsu also complies with applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies. For further details regarding Dentsu benefits, please visit www.dentsubenefitsplus.com. To begin the application process, please click on the "Apply" button at the top of this job posting. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and qualified candidates will be contacted for next steps. At dentsu, we believe great work happens when we're connected. Our way of working combines flexibility with in\-person collaboration to spark ideas and strengthen our teams. Employees who live within a commutable distance of one of our hub offices, currently located in Chicago, metro Detroit, Los Angeles, and New York City, are required and expected to work from the office three days per week (two days per week for employees based in Los Angeles). Dentsu may designate other Hub offices at any time. Those who live outside a commutable range may be designated as remote, depending on the role and business needs. Regardless of your work location, we expect our employees to be flexible to meet the needs of our Company and clients, which may include attendance in an office. \#LI\-EB1 \#LI\-HYBRID **Location:** Chicago \- N. jobs.title: Manager, Systems Engineering (DCL New Build)
jobs.description: The Walt Disney Company is a world\-class entertainment and technological leader. Walt’s passion was to continuously envision new ways to move audiences around the world—a passion that remains our touchstone in an enterprise that stretches from theme parks, resorts and a cruise line to sports, news, movies, and a variety of other businesses. Uniting each endeavor is a commitment to creating and delivering unforgettable experiences — and we’re constantly looking for new ways to enhance these exciting experiences. Bring your individual talents here and discover for yourself why a career with Disney is the opportunity you’ve been looking for. The Manager, Systems Engineering leads a team of Technical Project Managers and Engineers responsible for application deployment, integration, automation, validation, and commissioning activities across Disney Cruise Line New Build initiatives. The role partners closely with Systems Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), application teams, and business stakeholders to drive an automation\-first approach to how shipboard applications are deployed, tested, and commissioned throughout the ship lifecycle. The Manager will also champion the next generation of deployment and commissioning tooling, applying modern engineering practices and emerging technologies at every stage of a ship's life, from initial concept through maiden voyage. The candidate must possess the ability to share and communicate ideas clearly, both orally and in writing, to business sponsors and partners, technical resources, and executives, in clear concise language that is the effective for each respective group. The Manager must be able to manage competing priorities across New Build capital efforts. An ability to balance technology and business priorities is key for this role. **Responsibilities and Expectations**: In this role, you will manage a professional engineering team and Project Managers responsible for the end\-to\-end lifecycle of technical solutions that support Disney Cruise Line New Build initiatives, ensuring quality, volume, and timeliness objectives are consistently met. You will guide and persuade partners and stakeholders, adapt to evolving project priorities, and create a collaborative, customer\-focused environment where creative, detail\-oriented engineers can do their best work. Success requires strong technical depth, clear communication, and the ability to plan, prioritize, and hold yourself and others accountable. * Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Technical Project Managers and partner with Systems Engineers responsible for application deployment, integration, and commissioning across the New Build portfolio. * Manage and oversee application integration efforts across the Disney Cruise Line New Ship Build projects, ensuring systems function as a unified platform across all stages of the application deployment pipeline. * Provide governance and leadership across application implementation activities, mentoring the team to support ship readiness while ensuring alignment with delivery milestones and the maiden voyage timeline. * Lead the design of an automation\-first deployment pipeline strategy, ensuring alignment with application teams, release managers, business stakeholders, and technical operations. * Guide installation of operating systems, databases, and utilities software, and represent New Build in design discussions for systems and infrastructure solutions. * Partner with product, application and business teams to define strategies, expectations, and priorities, translating organizational goals into clear outcomes and roadmaps for your team. * Oversee financials and budgets for new build, including forecasting, accruals, and cost optimization for systems and services * Serve as a trusted technical liaison across Disney Cruise Line, Walt Disney Imagineering, third\-party vendors, and international stakeholders. * Champion new initiatives that advance the organization toward the desired state architecture and delivery model. * Partner with Systems Engineering (SE) and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams, including a dotted\-line working relationship with SRE engineers focused on developing deployment and commissioning tools to modernize build, test, and deployment pipelines supporting shipboard systems. * Partner with Systems Engineering leadership to continuously simplify, automate, and standardize across the Disney Cruise Line ecosystem through infrastructure\-as\-code, CI/CD pipelines, scripting, and emerging technologies. * Foster a platform\-engineering mindset, equipping teams with shared platforms, automation, and self\-service capabilities aligned to the desired state architecture. * Sponsor adoption of emerging tools and platforms that accelerate engineering productivity, reduce manual effort, and improve confidence across build, test, and release. * Provide advisory leadership by designing and recommending delivery strategies for external partners, supporting execution without direct ownership. * Support Executive leadership by clearly articulating risks, tradeoffs, and long‑term strategic decisions. * Serve as an escalation point for application readiness and testing activities, partnering with business and technical teams to remove blockers and maintain delivery momentum. * Develop resource plan to support the build of new ships. Ensuring smooth and efficient transition to operational teams. **Required Qualifications:** * Minimum 8 years of related technology experience with at least 3\+ years leading projects and coordinating efforts across diverse technical and business teams. * Hands\-on experience with automation and infrastructure tooling (e.g., Ansible, Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, configuration management, and CI/CD practices). * Demonstrated experience guiding system or infrastructure architecture, including scalability, performance optimization, and security best practices. * Excellent communication and persuasive leadership skills, with the ability to influence a matrixed organization and collaborate with stakeholders, vendors, and customers. * Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and decision\-making skills, with accountability for team performance and delivery outcomes. * Experience managing budgets and financial processes for technology portfolios, including forecasting and accruals. * Practical experience with Agile or similar software delivery methodologies and working with cross\-functional delivery teams. * Manage projects in a multi\-vendor environment including offshore teams. * Proficient with scripting (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) and modern version control workflows (Git). * Exposure to AI\-assisted development, testing, or operations tooling. * 10% Travel **Preferred Qualifications:** * Prior experience in travel, hospitality, cruise, or related industries supporting large\-scale guest or customer experiences. * A bias toward experimentation and adoption of emerging tools that improve delivery speed, quality, and engineer experience * Background managing or partnering with software engineering teams delivering highly scalable, high\-volume applications and platforms. * Industry certifications in cloud, systems engineering, or related technologies (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes). * Master’s degree in related discipline or equivalent work experience * Experience in ship build projects and process. * Familiarity with shipboard deployment environments, and/or with global, multi\-site rollouts. * Familiarity with cybersecurity\-by\-design principles, including IACS E26/E27 or similar maritime frameworks. **Required Education:** * Bachelor’s Degree\+ in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent work experience. \#TECHATDISNEY The hiring range for this position in Orlando, FL is $135,200 to $181,200 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

jobs.description: **Location**: U.S.A based \- Remote **Segment**: InSite **Direct Report To:** Senior R\&D Director Duracell is seeking a Principal IoT Data Platform Architect to own the architecture, implementation framework, security, governance, and evolution of the Procell InSite data platform. This role spans IoT devices, Azure, Databricks, analytics, AI/ML, APIs, and customer\-facing applications. This hands\-on technical authority will set standards, implement and test critical platform elements, establish secure reusable frameworks, and drive scalability, reliability, and product innovation. The role is a senior individual contributor operating through technical leadership and direct contribution. Responsibilities **Data Platform Leadership** * Own the platform roadmap, target architecture, transition plans, technical debt priorities, and architecture decisions. * Lead architecture and implementation across device\-to\-cloud ingestion, storage, processing, analytics, APIs, and applications. * Establish reference architectures, engineering standards, reusable frameworks, decision records, and exception controls. * Define system boundaries and integration contracts across Firmware, Cloud, Data, Software, Analytics, Security, Product, and IT. * Translate product needs into measurable requirements for latency, scale, availability, recovery, quality, security, and cost. **Data Engineering \& Architecture** * Design and implement batch, streaming, event\-driven, and API\-based pipelines connecting devices, cloud services, analytics, and applications. * Own the telemetry lifecycle from device identity and ingestion through validation, enrichment, storage, serving, retention, and deletion. * Define event schemas, data models and contracts, schema evolution, replay, idempotency, deduplication, and ordering controls. * Implement lakehouse and streaming patterns with governed raw, validated, curated, and product\-ready data layers. * Create scalable storage, processing, and serving patterns for telemetry, alerts, APIs, analytics, AI/ML, and low\-code applications. * Establish data quality, lineage, observability, ownership, issue routing, and measurable service levels. * Build production\-ready reference implementations and perform integration, contract, performance, resilience, security, and regression testing. * Lead capacity planning, workload isolation, scale testing, backfill, correction, replay, and migration strategies. **Governance \& Security** * Own Procell InSite governance for metadata, stewardship, classification, retention, lineage, auditability, and trusted datasets. * Define Unity Catalog architecture and integration with the enterprise governance ecosystem. * Implement least\-privilege access, managed identities, secrets, encryption, key management, private connectivity, and security monitoring. * Own secure platform boundaries across Azure, Databricks, storage, networks, environments, APIs, and customer tenants. * Ensure tenant isolation and alignment with enterprise, contractual, privacy, cybersecurity, residency, retention, and audit requirements. * Perform threat modeling and security reviews for ingestion, data sharing, APIs, AI, and external integrations. **Cloud \& Platform Strategy** * Define and implement Azure and Databricks architecture and guardrails for ingestion, storage, processing, orchestration, serving, governance, and monitoring. * Own platform topology across subscriptions, resource groups, environments, regions, networks, identities, storage, and workspaces. * Implement infrastructure as code, source control, automated testing, CI/CD, environment promotion, deployment validation, and rollback. * Establish service objectives and observability for ingestion, latency, freshness, availability, performance, and recovery. * Define disaster recovery, backup, restore, RTO/RPO, regional recovery, dependency\-failure, and recovery\-testing strategies. * Drive capacity forecasting, cost attribution, budget controls, unit\-cost measurement, platform lifecycle, and build\-versus\-buy decisions. **Technical Leadership** * Serve as the technical authority, approve target architectures and standards, and lead design and exception reviews. * Convert approved designs into working frameworks, reference implementations, test strategies, and production\-ready patterns. * Remain hands\-on in critical design, coding, configuration, prototyping, troubleshooting, performance testing, and security validation. * Partner across engineering, product, cybersecurity, QA, operations, IT, and strategic vendors to deliver integrated solutions. * Mentor engineers and architects and communicate technical tradeoffs, risks, and investment recommendations to leadership. **Qualifications** **Must\-Have** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 10\+ years in cloud, software, data engineering, or platform architecture, including 5\+ years leading complex production data\-platform architecture. * Demonstrated hands\-on ownership of large\-scale production cloud data platforms and secure multi\-tenant architectures. * Production experience with IoT telemetry, event\-driven systems, high\-volume streaming, and distributed\-system failure modes. * Deep experience with Azure and Databricks, including Spark, Delta Lake, lakehouse design, performance optimization, and Unity Catalog. * Experience with IoT Hub, Event Hubs, Kafka, Structured Streaming, or comparable event and streaming technologies. * Strong SQL and proficiency in Python, Scala, Java, C\#, or a comparable platform\-development language. * Experience with data modeling, APIs, integration contracts, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, automated testing, and observability. * Experience implementing security, governance, lineage, access controls, tenant isolation, auditability, disaster recovery, and cloud cost controls. * Ability to turn ambiguous product requirements into secure, testable architectures, working implementations, and executable roadmaps. * Ability to defend architecture decisions with engineering, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, product, vendors, and executives. **Nice\-to\-Have** * Experience with connected\-device fleets, device registries or twins, real\-time alerting, and condition\-monitoring platforms. * Experience with customer\-facing Data\-as\-a\-Service, SaaS, governed data sharing, Power BI, low\-code, or generative AI platforms. * Experience leading platform modernization or migration while maintaining production availability. * Azure or Databricks certifications; master's degree in a technical discipline. Pay: $130,908\.95 \- $157,653\.80 per year Work Location: Remote
