jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: **About Priorities USA** Priorities USA runs effective, large\-scale, digital voter mobilization and persuasion campaigns in key battleground states. We invest in cutting\-edge research and data. We build training and tools to grow our collective, progressive power. In partnership with movement allies, we employ innovative digital strategies and empower voters. **Position Summary** We are looking for a data science contractor who will support R\&D efforts to prototype Priorities USA’s next generation of digital intelligence tools in addition to experimentation on new data methods to be applied to digital campaigns. This role will sit at the intersection of data science and software engineering, requiring a strong intuition for understanding and applying data \& statistical methods as well as the ability to maintain rigorous shared software development standards within a team. This person will be involved with prototyping, evaluating, and implementing methods and features geared at helping digital media practitioners run more efficient and effective campaigns. The role is ideal for someone with a strong foundation in data science, who is excited by innovation, and is eager to apply those skills in service of progressive causes. The contractor will work directly with the Senior Director of R\&D. This is a remote engagement. Contractors must be based in the United States and will provide their own equipment. We expect availability for regular check\-ins during Eastern Time business hours. **Scope of Work*** Explore, prototype, and validate new analytical methods and LLM applications across a range of political, media, and advertising data contexts. * Build proof\-of\-concept tools, features, and datasets, and iterate on them based on feedback from digital practitioners. * Engineer validated methods into modular, sturdy, well\-documented pipelines and applications that are ready to graduate into production systems. * Develop software primarily through agentic development workflows, producing well\-specified, reviewable, tested, and documented code. * Think critically about what data is saying and communicate findings, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences. **Qualifications*** Strong programming skills in SQL and Python. * Demonstrated ability to apply statistical and data science methods in real\-world contexts. * Strong software engineering habits (version control, code review, testing, documentation). * Hands\-on experience applying LLMs in real projects — e.g., prompt and context engineering, classification or extraction pipelines, evaluation of model outputs, or agentic frameworks. * Experience working with agentic software development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Codex). * Experience working with GCP (and preferably AWS), including building and maintaining data pipelines. * Experience using git \+ GitHub * Familiarity with cybersecurity best practices * Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across teams with different working styles and levels of technical experience. * Demonstrated curiosity and self\-directed exploration through side projects, prototypes, experiments, or other evidence that you build and try things on your own initiative. * Experience communicating with diverse groups, working in a multicultural workforce, and bringing a sensitivity and appreciation of cultural differences **Preferred Qualifications*** Experience working with digital advertising, media performance, social listening, or media consumption data. * Experience working with political, advocacy, or campaign data such as voter files. * Experience with containerization and orchestration. * Experience developing front\-end applications or dashboards. * Experience building evaluation frameworks or benchmarks for LLM or ML systems. **Compensation** Compensation for this engagement is $125–175 per hour, commensurate with experience. **Equal Opportunity Employer** People of color, women, people with disabilities, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. If you need an accommodation for a disability to apply to this position, please let us know by emailing peopleops@priorities.org. **Application Information** Applications will be accepted until the role is filled. Applications should include a resume and a link to a GitHub profile or relevant work samples; a cover letter is optional. The process for selected candidates will consist of a compensated take\-home exercise and two rounds of interviews with members of the team. We are aiming for a start date in mid\-October. **This engagement runs through December 31, 2026\.**

jobs.title: Founding Design Engineer
jobs.description: **Probook** Probook is the AI Operating System for the home services industry, transforming how plumbing, HVAC, and electrical businesses operate. Our impact is real. Dispatching the right technician to the right job can mean the difference between a $300 "band\-aid" fix and a $20,000 system replacement. By automating previously high\-touch workflows around\-the\-clock, Probook ensures a consistent customer experience without the need for 24/7 live staffing. We unify our customers' processes into a single, scalable platform, giving businesses one place to run their entire dispatch operation. **The role** You are our first designer. You own how Probook looks, feels, and works across the web app, mobile, and Chrome extension, and you ship the frontend yourself. That second part is not a stretch goal. Most of what you design, you will build and merge. If your process ends at a Figma handoff, this is not the role. The software this industry runs on looks like it was designed in 2008\. For a lot of our operators, Probook is the best\-designed product they use at work. You set that bar from here. **What you'll do** * Own UI/UX quality across all three surfaces, end to end * Ship production frontend changes yourself — design through merge * Establish Probook's visual and interaction language from scratch * Sit in on customer calls, watch operators work, and turn what you see into things that ship * Partner with engineers from spec to ship, and with the founders on product direction * Use Claude Code, Cursor, and similar to go from problem to multiple working flows in a day **What we're looking for** **Required:** * 4–6 years of product design experience, ideally 2\+ years at startups * A track record of merging your own frontend code to production. We will ask for specifics and look at the work. * B2B or ops\-heavy product background. * Strong portfolio of shipped product work * Turnaround in hours, not weeks, without dropping quality **What separates the top of the pool:** * Taste you can't switch off \- you see the typographic inconsistency and you fix it * You can explain why a decision is right, not just show the artifact * You explore the problem properly before converging, then converge fast * You pick the important flow over the interesting one without being told * You get dangerous on incomplete context quickly * You're getting better at this on your own time **Compensation** * $180K–$230K base, meaningful early\-stage equity * Medical, dental, vision * $500/month Ramp card, $25 nightly dinner credit * In\-office five days a week in Manhattan

jobs.title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: At Prologis, we don’t just lead the industry—we define it with a 1\.3 billion square foot portfolio and an annual throughput of approximately $3\.2 trillion. We create the intelligent infrastructure that powers global commerce, seamlessly connecting the digital and physical worlds. From agile supply chains to energy solutions, our ecosystems help your business move faster, operate smarter and grow sustainably. With unmatched scale, innovation and expertise, Prologis is a category of one—not just shaping the future of logistics but building what comes next.**Job Title:** Lead Forward Deployed Engineer**Company:** Prologis **A day in the life** --------------------- The Lead FDE partners with business teams to reimagine how work gets done with AI and leads the technical delivery of Prologis' most complex business\-embedded AI deployments while remaining hands\-on in architecture, code, evaluation and production implementation. As our first FDE hire, you will help establish this capability at Prologis and shape how we turn AI into new ways of working and measurable business results. You will be deliberately assigned to a primary Prologis business domain. External hires will generally remain in that anchor domain for 9 to 12 months, and potentially longer, while leading several discrete deployments. This extended assignment allows deep technical expertise to be paired with Prologis operating context and business credibility without creating permanent embedded support. You will structure ambiguous programs, set technical direction, guide Senior FDEs and partner engineers, resolve cross\-functional blockers and create patterns that can be reused across Prologis. You will remain accountable for meeting agreed business acceptance criteria and supporting validation through production release, technical stabilization and ownership transfer. This is a senior individual\-contributor position and does not require direct people management. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Build deep fluency in an anchor domain and lead a portfolio of deployments spanning multiple workflows, business units or enterprise systems. * Ensure each deployment has defined outcomes, sponsorship, architecture, milestones, production ownership and a handoff plan. * Work directly with business leaders, frontline users and AI Product to identify high\-value opportunities, understand how work is done today and challenge assumptions about how it could work with AI, informing the value case, success measures and operating constraints for each deployment. * Translate strategic objectives into redesigned workflows that remove unnecessary steps and handoffs and combine AI agents, software and human judgment effectively; define the technical roadmaps, deployment architectures, dependencies and acceptance criteria needed to deliver them. * Architect, build, test and troubleshoot production\-grade AI applications, agents, retrieval systems, integrations and workflow solutions. * Set technical direction for FDE deployments and guide implementation across Senior FDEs, central AI engineers and partner teams. * Resolve tradeoffs among business value, engineering quality, security, speed, maintainability and cost. * Design representative test sets, acceptance thresholds, regression testing, observability, security, privacy, auditability and human controls into the solution. * Coordinate closely with central AI Product, Applied AI Engineering, Platform, Data and Knowledge, Security and Governance, Process and Agent Orchestration, Enablement, Architecture and AI Operations teams. * Facilitate business validation against agreed acceptance criteria, resolve technical defects and partner with business owners and Enablement to address adoption barriers and validate workflow improvements during rollout and stabilization. Establish production\-readiness and handoff criteria, and ensure solutions have durable ownership after deployment. * Business owners retain accountability for value baselines, adoption, change management and value realization; the FDE partners with them on process redesign, adoption barriers and validation of workflow improvements. * Identify patterns that should become shared capabilities, reusable components, evaluation assets or reference architectures. * Mentor Senior FDEs and raise the quality of technical discovery, engineering, evaluation and stakeholder communication. * Provide concise executive reporting on value, delivery progress, risks, tradeoffs and decisions. * Help define the Prologis FDE delivery methodology, engineering standards and engagement playbooks. **How success will be measured** -------------------------------- * Complex deployments progress beyond demonstrations and pilots into stable production, meet agreed technical, delivery and business acceptance criteria, and demonstrate improvements in how work gets done, validated with business owners against agreed baselines. * Multiple workstreams remain aligned an tly with senior business executives and translate strategy into executable technical work. * Strong product judgment to distinguish reusable patterns from one\-off customization and make disciplined build, buy or stop decisions. * Demonstrated ability to create reusable engineering components, evaluation assets, standards and playbooks. * Strong written and verbal communication, including executive communication and technical design documentation. * Ability to acquire deep domain context quickly and use it to make sound enterprise delivery tradeoffs. * A formal engineering or computer\-science degree is not required when equivalent practical experience and demonstrated technical leadership are present. **Preferred** ------------- * Experience extending successful AI workflow transformations across business units or geographies within a large global enterprise. * Deep knowledge of one or more Prologis business domains or adjacent industries. * Experience leading several parallel deployments or a portfolio of related AI use cases. * Experience building shared AI components, governed retrieval, knowledge architectures, reference architectures or enterprise developer tooling. * Experience with cloud and hybrid deployment patterns, including enterprise security and compliance reviews. * Experience with AWS, Dataiku, SQL, automated testing, containers and CI/CD. * Experience mentoring senior engineers and leading work across internal teams, vendors and consulting partners. * Experience defining and measuring technical quality, reliability, efficiency and cost outcomes. * Willingness to travel periodically to Prologis offices and operating locations to work directly with business teams. **Hiring Salary Range of:** $200,000 \- $285,000\. Salary and whole compensation package (bonus target) to be determined by the candidate’s location, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. \#LI\-KR1**People First** Each of us working at Prologis plays an essential role in the enduring success of our company. We value people who are decisive, courageous and adaptable. While we are one company, locations and departments operate with autonomy and accountability. **Individuals take the initiative here.** When you join Prologis, you work shoulder to shoulder with some of the top talent in the industry to do the best work of your career. Every employee belongs. Every employee contributes. **Employees advance their careers here.** As a successful global enterprise, Prologis has never lost sight of what matters most, our strong belief that our people are the most important part of our business. And because of that, we provide a generous total rewards package and take a lot of time to focus on quality management and leadership development. **People come first here.** All full\-time roles in the US come with a robust benefits package which includes healthcare, dental, and vision insurance for employees and eligible dependents. Prologis also offers several other wellness, financial, and work/lifestyle\-specific benefits. Our 401(k) retirement plan has a company match of 50% up to 12% of eligible compensation. We also offer generous PTO with a starting accrual of 22 days a year in addition to paid holidays and volunteer time. All job offers are contingent upon successful completion of background verification. Prologis is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religions, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.**Employment Type:** Full time**Location:** Denver, Colorado**Additional Locations:** Atlanta, Georgia, Cerritos, California, Chicago, Illinois, Dallas, Texas, Nashville, Tennessee, New York, New York, Phoenix, Arizona, San Francisco, California, Seattle, Washington

jobs.description: **Company:** ------------ Qualcomm France S.A.R.L. **Job Area:** ------------- Operations Group, Operations Group \> Project Manager **General Summary:** The Open Source Technology Team (OSTT) drives Qualcomm's open source enablement strategy across multiple technology domains including Linux Kernel, Zephyr, Open Boot Firmware, Linux Distributions, Testing Infrastructure, Kernel Testing \& CI, LAVA, and related upstream ecosystems. Facilitate collaboration between Qualcomm engineering teams and open source stakeholders. * **Process Improvement** * Continuously improve project management practices, tooling, reporting, and governance. * Introduce scalable methodologies for managing large engineering portfolios. * Promote automation, AI\-assisted workflows, and operational efficiencies. jobs.title: Global Quality Systems Manager
jobs.description: Fairport, NY, United States **Global Quality Systems Manager** **Position Summary** The Global Quality Systems Manager is responsible for leading and continuously improving Qualitrol's global Quality Management System (QMS) to ensure compliance with customer, regulatory, and international quality standards. This role serves as the global process owner for quality systems, document control, audit management, corrective and preventive action effectiveness, quality data governance, and enterprise quality applications. The Global Quality Systems Manager collaborates with Quality, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Service, and Commercial teams to standardize quality processes across all Qualitrol locations while supporting site\-specific business needs. This position drives a proactive culture of compliance, continuous improvement, digital transformation, and operational excellence. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** **Global Quality Management System Leadership** * Own and maintain the global Quality Management System (QMS) architecture, policies, procedures, standards, and governance framework. * Ensure consistent implementation and adherence to global quality processes across all sites. * Lead global process standardization initiatives while supporting appropriate local requirements. * Manage periodic QMS reviews and drive continuous improvement of quality system effectiveness. * Serve as the global process owner for key quality system workflows and performance metrics. **Regulatory and Certification Compliance** * Lead maintenance of ISO 9001 certification and support implementation of additional standards as required. * Coordinate external certification, surveillance, customer, and regulatory audits. * Ensure audit readiness across all global locations. * Monitor emerging regulatory requirements and assess impacts to Qualitrol operations. * Support compliance initiatives related to customer\-specific requirements and industry regulations. **Internal Audit Program Management** * Develop and maintain the global internal audit program. * Train and mentor internal auditors across locations. * Ensure audit findings are effectively addressed through timely corrective actions. * Monitor closure and effectiveness of audit\-related corrective actions. * Report audit performance and risks to leadership. **Document Control and Quality Governance** * Manage the global document control process and documentation hierarchy. * Ensure controlled documents remain current, compliant, and accessible. * Maintain governance of quality records, retention requirements, and revision control. * Support deployment and standardization of best practices across functions and sites. **Enterprise Quality Systems Management** * Serve as business owner for the enterprise Quality Management System (eQMS). * Drive system implementation, enhancements, configuration management, validation, and user adoption. * Maintain data integrity across quality applications and reporting platforms. * Partner with IT and business stakeholders on digital quality initiatives. * Lead training programs related to quality systems, workflows, and reporting tools. **CAPA and Nonconformance System Effectiveness** * Govern enterprise Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) processes. * Monitor nonconformance, deviation, and corrective action system performance. * Facilitate root cause analysis and corrective action effectiveness reviews. * Drive closure of systemic quality issues through structured problem\-solving methodologies. **Quality Data and KPI Management** * Establish and maintain global quality reporting standards. * Ensure accuracy and consistency of quality performance metrics. * Analyze enterprise quality trends and identify opportunities for improvement. * Develop executive dashboards and management review reporting. * Support data\-driven decision making through meaningful quality analytics. **Leadership and Continuous Improvement** * Lead, coach, and develop Quality Systems professionals and quality analysts. * Promote Lean, Six Sigma, and continual improvement methodologies throughout the organization. * Facilitate cross\-functional quality improvement initiatives. * Support strategic quality objectives and annual operating plans. * Drive a proactive quality culture focused on prevention and systems thinking. **Qualifications** **Education** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Operations, Business, or related technical field required. * Master's degree preferred. **Experience** * Minimum 8\-10 years of progressive quality leadership experience in a manufacturing environment. * Minimum 5 years of Quality Management System ownership or quality systems leadership experience. * Proven experience managing multi\-site quality systems and compliance programs. * Experience leading ISO certification and surveillance audits. * Experience implementing or administering enterprise QMS software solutions. **Technical Knowledge** * Expert knowledge of ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems. * Strong knowledge of corrective action systems, CAPA, root cause analysis, and audit methodologies. * Experience with document control systems and quality governance processes. * Knowledge of PFMEA, DFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, APQP, PPAP, and structured problem\-solving methodologies. * Experience with enterprise quality platforms such as ComplianceQuest, Oracle Fusion QMS, ETQ, or equivalent systems. **Preferred Certifications** * ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE) * ASQ Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) * ISO 9001 Lead Auditor * Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt **Key Performance Indicators** The Global Quality Systems Manager is accountable for: * Successful maintenance of global ISO certifications. * Internal and external audit performance. * CAPA closure effectiveness and timeliness. * Quality system compliance and process adherence. * eQMS adoption and system utilization. * Document control cycle time and effectiveness. * Quality data integrity and reporting accuracy. * Global quality training compliance. * Reduction of recurring systemic quality issues. **Core Competencies** * Strategic Quality Leadership * Quality Management Systems Expertise * Regulatory Compliance Management * Audit Leadership * Change Management * Data Analytics and Reporting * Continuous Improvement * Cross\-Functional Collaboration * Process Governance * Coaching and Talent Development **Location:** Fairport, NY (Global Responsibility) **Reports To:** Director of Global Quality **Travel:** Up to 25% domestic and international \#LI\-PW1 **Ralliant Corporation Overview** Ralliant, originally part of Fortive, now stands as a bold, independent public company driving innovation at the forefront of precision technology. With a global footprint and a legacy of excellence, we empower engineers to bring next\-generation breakthroughs to life — faster, smarter, and more reliably. Our high\-performance instruments, sensors, and subsystems fuel mission\-critical advancements across industries, enabling real\-world impact where it matters most. At Ralliant we're building the future, together with those driven to push boundaries, solve complex problems, and leave a lasting mark on the world. **About Qualitrol** QUALITROL manufactures monitoring and protection devices for high value electrical assets and OEM manufacturing companies. We are the largest and most trusted global leader for partial discharge monitoring, asset protection equipment and information products across power generation, transmission, and distribution. Ralliant and all Ralliant Companies are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer I
jobs.description: Are you excited by the opportunity to serve as the technical anchor of a cross\-functional engineering squad, driving architecture decisions, mentoring peers, and shaping the future of a next\-generation healthcare data platform? Would you like to work in an AI\-accelerated development environment where you can leverage tools like GitHub Copilot while building scalable Java, React, and Python solutions that directly improve healthcare data quality and patient outcomes? **About the Business** LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Healthcare vertical, we help payers and providers improve data quality, operational efficiency, and member outcomes through market\-leading provider data management solutions. You can learn more at https://risk.lexisnexis.com. **About the Team** You'll join a collaborative Healthcare engineering squad at LexisNexis Risk Solutions, building and modernizing the platforms behind provider data management and identity solutions for payers and providers. Our cross\-functional agile teams \- engineers, QA, product, and analysts \- value strong technical ownership, accountability, and shared delivery. We embrace an AI\-accelerated SDLC and modern Copilot\-based workflows, so you'll have real influence on architecture, quality, and outcomes from day one. **About the Role** This position performs complex research, design, and software development within our provider data management product line, and is expected to serve as the technical anchor for a cross\-functional engineering squad. While this is an individual\-contributor role, the successful candidate will operate with a high degree of technical ownership and influence—setting design direction, guiding the team through delivery, and acting as the primary technical point of contact across product, QA, and partner squads. You will balance hands\-on engineering across a suite of full\-stack Java/React applications with strong technical ownership: reviewing code, driving estimates and release readiness, resolving complex issues, and mentoring peers. You will also build and support Python\-based data\-processing and delivery pipelines that generate and transmit data to downstream clients, and work within our AI\-accelerated software development lifecycle using approved AI coding assistants to raise quality and velocity. Over time, this role will help extend our platform toward a consolidated, next\-generation healthcare data platform. **Responsibilities** * Act as the squad's technical anchor, owning design direction and safeguarding quality, security, and performance across its applications, services, and data pipelines. * Design/Build and maintain Java Spring Boot apps, React UI apps and Python\-based data\-processing and delivery pipelines, ensuring accurate, reliable, and timely data delivery to downstream clients. * Lead code reviews and uphold coding best practices; complete complex feature development and bug fixes. * Drive backlog refinement, technical estimation, and sprint/release readiness in an Agile environment. * Serve as the primary technical liaison for cross\-team dependencies, integrations, and risk resolution. * Champion AI\-accelerated SDLC practices and mentor peers on effective, responsible use of approved AI tooling. **Qualifications** * BS in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with a demonstrated track record of owning technical direction and guiding delivery on a cross\-functional team. * Proven full\-stack delivery in Java and a modern JavaScript framework, plus demonstrated Python experience building data\-processing or data\-delivery pipelines. * Exposure to AI\-assisted development workflows. **Technical Skills** * Advanced proficiency in Java / J2EE and the Spring Boot framework for building RESTful microservices. * Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and React for modern, component\-based front ends. * Proficiency in Python for building and maintaining data\-processing and delivery pipelines—including data transformation, delta/batch file generation, validation, and automated client data delivery. * Working knowledge of workflow orchestration and scheduled batch processing (e.g., Airflow or equivalent), and experience with distributed or large\-scale data\-processing frameworks. * Solid grasp of relational and NoSQL data stores (SQL, document databases) and search/indexing technologies. * Experience with cloud\-native development on Azure (AKS, App Services, Cosmos, Others), Docker, and Kubernetes. * Strong command of CI/CD (GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps), Git branching strategy, and test\-driven development. * AI\-accelerated development: hands\-on experience with AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot in VS Code and IntelliJ), effective prompt engineering, and AI\-assisted code review, test generation, and refactoring. jobs.title: Senior Controls Engineer, Optical Beam Pointing
jobs.description: At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known. Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us. **About the Team:** The Interplanetary Sciences Program was established to expand access to scientific exploration across our solar system. Its mission is to make planetary research faster, more affordable, and more capable than ever before by rethinking how science missions are designed, built, and operated. The program aims to enable scientists to send instruments to distant worlds without decades of development or prohibitive costs. By creating a sustainable model for interplanetary exploration, we are transforming space science from an occasional event into a continuous process of discovery that accelerates knowledge, broadens participation, and inspires the next generation of explorers. **About the Role:** As a Senior Controls Engineer within the Interplanetary Sciences Program, you will be the technical lead for optical beam pointing and control systems that enable high\-precision optical communications for our 2028 Mars Orbiter mission. You will design, develop, and implement the control algorithms that measure the subsystem orientation using advanced sensor fusion and actively steer both spacecraft attitude and beam orientation to maintain precision optical links across interplanetary distances. This role requires end\-to\-end technical ownership of a mission\-critical control system that integrates optical sensors, gyroscopic measurements, spacecraft attitude control, and fast steering mirror systems. You will develop engineering methods, control architectures, and flight\-ready algorithms that enable the spacecraft to acquire, track, and maintain optical beam pointing while rejecting spacecraft jitter and environmental disturbances. You will work across communications, GNC, flight software, and spacecraft systems teams to ensure the optical beam pointing system meets performance requirements from design through prototyping, ground testing, launch, cruise, and orbital operations at Mars. **What You'll Do:** * Own the design, development, and implementation of optical beam pointing and control algorithms for the 2028 Mars Orbiter mission. * Develop control systems that integrate optical sensor measurements, gyroscopic data, and spacecraft attitude estimates to achieve precision beam pointing and tracking. * Design and implement fast steering mirror control algorithms that reject spacecraft jitter and maintain optical link performance during dynamic conditions. * Develop sensor fusion and state estimation algorithms that combine beacon position measurements with inertial sensing to enable robust pointing control. * Define requirements, interfaces, and verification methods for optical beam pointing performance, including acquisition, tracking, and pointing stability metrics. * Develop and maintain control system models, simulation environments, and analysis tools to predict and verify system performance. * Work with flight software developers to define software requirements, architectures, and interfaces for control algorithm implementation. * Support prototyping and ground testing of optical beam pointing systems, including hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing and system\-level verification. * Serve as technical authority for optical beam pointing and control, working across communications, GNC, spacecraft systems, and flight software teams. * Support flight operations during commissioning and on\-orbit operations, including performance analysis and anomaly resolution. **About You:** * An undergraduate or graduate degree (BS/MS/PhD) in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Control Systems, Physics, or a similar technical discipline with 3\+ years of related experience * Strong background in control systems design and implementation, including classical and modern control theory, state\-space methods, and nonlinear control * Experience with spacecraft guidance, navigation, and control systems for launch vehicles, satellites, or other aerospace applications * Experience developing sensor fusion and state estimation algorithms, including Kalman filtering, observer design, or similar techniques * Strong software development skills in at least one high\-level language (e.g. C\+\+, Rust) and at least one scripting language (e.g. Python, Matlab) * Ability to work in a fast\-paced startup environment with a high degree of autonomy and independence * Ability to complete projects with ownership of end\-to\-end solutions and deliver results on schedule * Ability to work across disciplines and clearly communicate technical decisions, requirements, and tradeoffs to engineering stakeholders **Nice to Have, but not required:** ----------------------------------- * A graduate degree (MS/PhD) in engineering or physics * Prior work in a technical leadership role for spacecraft or satellite development * Experience with image processing algorithms and photon counting detector systems * Experience developing or implementing flight software for real\-time control systems * Experience with fast steering mirror systems, fine pointing mechanisms, or other precision actuation systems * Experience with gyroscopic sensors, IMUs, and inertial measurement processing for spacecraft applications * Familiarity with spacecraft attitude determination and control systems (ADCS) * Experience with modeling and simulation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink for control system development * Prior work in a startup or agile development environment * Experience supporting spacecraft prototyping, ground testing, integration, or flight operations * Familiarity with deep\-space or interplanetary mission operations * Experience with optical communications, laser pointing and tracking systems, or gimballed RF antenna pointing systems * Experience working with software developers to define requirements and architectures for flight\-critical control systems **We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.** ***If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at*** ***accommodations@relativityspace.com******.*** ***Please note: Relativity Space does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate profiles, or referrals from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited submission \- via email, our website, social media, or directly to an employee \- will be deemed the property of Relativity Space, and no fee will be owed absent a current, fully executed agreement with Talent Acquisition that specifically authorizes submissions for the applicable role.***

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Financial AI Product
jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. ### **About the Financial AI Product Team** Rippling’s Financial Product team builds the systems that power some of the most critical financial workflows for modern businesses — including payroll, payments, reconciliation, compliance, and operational finance. These products sit at the intersection of money movement, employee trust, customer operations, and regulatory complexity. The work is high stakes: financial systems must be accurate, reliable, auditable, and resilient, even as they handle messy real\-world data and complex business rules across customers, countries, and use cases. We are using AI to make these workflows dramatically simpler. That means building systems that can interpret inconsistent data, automate manual review, surface exceptions, explain outcomes, and accelerate implementation — while preserving the deterministic controls financial products require. The goal is not AI for its own sake; it is practical, production\-grade AI that helps customers run financial workflows with more speed, confidence, and accuracy. As a Senior Software Engineer on this team, you will help define how AI becomes a core part of financial product and infrastructure at Rippling.### **What you will do** * Build AI\-powered product capabilities for complex financial workflows such as onboarding, data ingestion, reconciliation, validation, exception handling, and operational review. * Design systems that combine model\-driven reasoning with deterministic financial execution. * Build workflows that trace financial values back to source evidence, surface unresolved gaps, and prevent downstream execution when validation fails. * Create ingestion and normalization systems that can handle messy exports, historical records, customer\-provided files, and inconsistent provider formats. * Develop evals, testing harnesses, observability, and feedback loops to measure AI quality in workflows where “almost always right” is not good enough. * Partner closely with product, design, operations, compliance, and platform teams to identify high\-impact AI opportunities and turn them into reliable product capabilities. * Work through ambiguous product areas, prototype quickly, and scale successful solutions into reusable product and platform primitives. * Help set the engineering bar for correctness, auditability, security, reliability, and production safety in AI\-enabled and new AI native financial products. ### **What you will need** * Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production systems at meaningful scale. * Experience designing backend systems, data models, APIs, workflows, or platform infrastructure for complex business domains. * Strong judgment around reliability, correctness, edge cases, and operational risk. * Interest in applied AI, LLMs, agents, evals, retrieval, structured extraction, or AI\-assisted workflows. * Ability to reason clearly about where AI should be used, where deterministic systems should take over, and how to build guardrails around model\-driven workflows. * Product sense and comfort operating in ambiguous problem spaces where the right answer is not obvious upfront. * Ability to partner with product managers, domain experts, operations teams, and engineers to turn messy real\-world workflows into simple, scalable software. * A high\-ownership mindset: you can take a problem from vague customer pain through architecture, implementation, rollout, measurement, and iteration. ### **Additional Information** Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), **Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy**, to be an essential function of the employee's role. This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here. A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below. **The pay range for this role is:** 168,000 \- 280,000 USD per year(US Tier 1\)

From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software\-defined vehicles around the world. The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone. **Role Summary** ================ As RVT's Electronic Control Unit (ECU) portfolio scales across brand partners and expands into triple\-digit country roadmaps — against a backdrop of increasing semiconductor supply chain volatility — sustaining operations have shifted from a downstream function to a core strategic priority. Our Electrical Hardware Technical Program Management team is seeking a Senior Manager to build and lead the ECU sustaining engineering and operations — leveraging both in\-house expertise as well as outsourced debug, design, simulation, test/validation engineering services support to get the job done. This role sits at the intersection of engineering execution and programmatic strategy, requiring deep experience in ECU design as well as process development, coalition\-building and initiative leadership. . In this role, you will own the post\-launch lifecycle of ECU hardware across Zonal, Battery, Infotainment and Connectivity ECUs . This scope includes field return and RMA disposition, failure analysis and root cause, containment and corrective action with our contract manufacturers, engineering change and deviation control, component obsolescence and second\-source qualification, and cost\-down and end\-of\-life transitions. You will be the accountable owner for sustaining issues that reach the plant and/or field, and the person who converts what we learn there into design, test, process, and supplier improvements to integrate into our upstream NPI workflows.. This role also carries direct accountability for the third\-party engineering partners who deliver mechanical engineering and design, component engineering, and reliability test and validation for the ECU portfolio. You will define statements of work, set deliverable and quality expectations, manage capacity and spend, and ensure outsourced scope integrates cleanly with internal execution. The successful candidate brings strong program management instincts, a hands\-on technical foundation in electronics hardware, and the organizational influence to drive complex, multi\-team, multi\-supplier efforts to completion. **Responsibilities** ==================== * Build and lead best\-in\-class ECU sustaining engineering and operations team — failure analysis, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, technical program management, and document control — with domain coverage across Zonal, Battery, Infotainment ,Connectivity, and vehicle access ECUs. * Lead development and implementation of plant/field triage process across brand partners from greenfield state. Define and scale the sustaining operating model as the ECU portfolio grows across vehicle platforms and brand partner programs, including process definition, tooling, and a resource plan that balances internal headcount against outsourced scope. * Own the portfolio of engineering service providers and Contract Manufacture partners that deliver post\-ramp design, validation, qualification, and failure analysis — including the workflows, systems integration, and scalable processes that make sustaining operations repeatable across the ECU portfolio. Define statements of work, deliverables, capacity, and spend, and hold partners accountable to quality and schedule. * Drive for uninterrupted supply from build readiness through mass production: capacity and ramp planning, mitigation of shortages/EOL/single\-source risk, and the design refresh and ECO decisions required to keep products buildable in partnership with Purchasing organizations across brand partners. * Own the RMA and change\-management system with Co ivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies careers site (**https://rivianvw.tech/\#careers**). **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at candidateaccommodations@rivian.com. **Candidate Data Privacy** -------------------------- Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies” may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) record keeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law. Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may share your Candidate Personal Data with (i) internal personnel who have a need to know such information in order to perform their duties, including individuals on our People Team, Finance, Legal, and the team(s) with the position(s) for which you are applying; (ii) Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies affiliates; and (iii) Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies’ service providers, including providers of background checks, staffing services, and cloud services. Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may transfer or store internationally your Candidate Personal Data, including to or in the United States, Canada, and the European Union and in the cloud, and this data may be subject to the laws and accessible to the courts, law enforcement and national security authorities of such jurisdictions. If you provide a mobile telephone number as part of your application or during the recruitment process, Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may use that number to contact you via SMS text message for recruitment\-related purposes, including scheduling, logistics, and status updates. jobs.description: **About Roadpass:** Roadpass Digital revolutionizes road\-based travel and outdoor tourism through innovative products and services. We aim to empower travelers who love exploring the outdoors and are always ready for their next adventure. Our brands include Roadtrippers and Campendium. Roadpass makes those experiences more accessible and more memorable by making it easier than ever to hit the road. We empower travelers and businesses that understand the outdoors are meant to be explored, that roads are meant to be driven, and that your next adventure is right around the corner. Millions of travelers have discovered the benefits of Roadpass brands and the ability to make it easier to own and maintain recreational vehicles, which help them discover, book, and navigate road trips. * Roadtrippers is the \#1 road trip planning tool. Roadtrippers helps people discover the world around them in an entirely new way by streamlining discovery, planning, booking, and navigation into an engaging and intuitive process. * Campendium is a camping app that helps traveling families, couples, and soloists find an ideal campsite, verified by an entire community of campers. Features include map overlays for cell coverage and public lands so you can always find the perfect campsite. Campendium is free to use and will change how you find a place to call home for the night. We value our people and are committed to creating a healthy and fun culture for our team. We're \#hiring and looking for talented folks. Let's talk if you want to join a top tech company! **Role Overview:** The Senior AI/ML Engineer applies deep expertise in machine learning, applied AI, and creative engineering to ship intelligent, product\-driven solutions. This role partners with product, design, and engineering teams to turn advanced models and analytics into features that deliver real user value. The ideal candidate is technically curious, rigorous about detail, communicates clearly across disciplines, and thrives on solving hard problems in production settings. **Where You're Located:** Candidates for this role will be based in the United States and work remotely. **Requirements** * Champion a data\-driven and customer\-focused culture. * Maintain and scale the primary recommendation system for the core product. * Maintenance, implementation, and optimization of natural language AI tools including customer service chatbots for multiple brands. * Solve complex problems using advanced ML, AI, and mathematical modeling and optimization techniques with involvement in the whole lifecycle, including but not limited to pre\-processing, feature engineering, problem formulation, algorithmic selection/evaluation, modeling, hyper\-parameter tuning, and model deployment. * Use predictive modeling to increase and optimize customer experiences, revenue generation, ad targeting, and other business outcomes. * Mine and analyze data from company databases to optimize and improve product development, marketing techniques, and business strategies. * Design, develop, and implement production\-level code. Own the full development cycle: design, development, impact assessment, A/B testing (including interpretation of results), and production deployment. * Serve as a subject matter expert in data, advanced analytics, and visualization within Roadpass Digital, ensuring accurate interpretation of core business metrics, data models, and reports. * Coordinate with different functional teams to implement models and monitor outcomes. * Ensure the delivery of high\-quality data products. * Identify, design, and implement internal process improvements. **Experience:** * 5\+ years experience in advanced analytics, machine learning, analytics engineering, or similar highly analytical role. * Degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Information Systems, Analytics). * Strong experience with Python. * Strong experience with AWS services including S3, SageMaker, and Bedrock * Strong experience with AI engineering tooling (LangChain, LangGraph, and LangSmith) * Strong experience with RAG systems including vector databases (PGVector) * Advanced SQL knowledge to query data warehouses, including knowledge of CTEs and window functions. * Expertise in building, deploying and maintaining machine learning models in production. * Proven track record leading the development and delivery of advanced, actionable Data Science, Machine Learning / AI products and services, including creating predictive models that serve as a foundation for new product offerings. * Ability to identify and assess key opportunity areas where data science can enhance and improve existing products by increasing the efficiency of processes and accuracy of model/analytical results. * Strong analytical mind toward breaking down business questions with data answers. * Excellent organization, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to bring clarity to complexity and communicate customer needs, architectural requirements, and product goals across cross\-functional teams. * Ability to translate highly complex processes for non\-technical audiences. * Team player with proven ability to educate team members. * Self\-starter who thrives in an entrepreneurial, fast\-paced environment with a demonstrated capacity to lead, motivate, and work well with others. * Experience supporting and working with cross\-functional teams in a dynamic environment. * Confident in decision\-making and able to explain processes or choices as needed. **Benefits** * **Flexible Time Off \& 16 Company Paid Holidays:** We believe this is a partnership. We trust our employees to build their own time\-off schedules and encourage our teams to take time for their well\-being. * **Collaborative \& Inclusive Culture:** Our employees work in small, self\-organized, and cross\-functional teams that determine the best tactics to support the vision and strategy set by leadership. We encourage and welcome all ideas, taking an agile approach to creating an amazing product. * **Growth Opportunity:** Through hands\-on learning and development, the opportunities are endless. * **Focus on Well\-Being:** We pride ourselves on offering numerous benefit options to fit best the needs of our employees and their families, including domestic partners. Benefits include medical (PPO \& HDHP\-HSA), dental, vision, flexible spending account, commuter benefit, discount programs, life \& disability insurance, and accident insurance. We also offer a 401k program with company match and paid parental leave. * **Live your Passion:** We believe in living our mission and vision. jobs.title: Engineering Manager Software & AI (all genders welcome)
jobs.description: To strengthen our development team we are looking for a **Engineering Manager Software \& AI (all genders welcome)** ============================================================ We are a technology\-driven company with several innovative business units in the growth phase. While we maintain certain centralized structures, we foster an agile, start\-up\-like spirit. Our teams develop advanced AI and software solutions that process large sensor datasets, build intelligent cloud services, and power real\-time edge applications. We operate in domains where security, reliability, and engineering excellence are essential. In this international environment, you will lead a multidisciplinary engineering team working mostly remotely across different US regions. This position is fully remote for candidates on the US East Coast, or fully remote/hybrid in Germany (with office options in Wietmarschen\-Lohne, Osnabrück, or Bremen). This role requires travel to in\-person workshops: approximately 2 per year in the US and 2–3 per year in Germany. This role reports to the Head of Software and AI, with additional task management from the Head of AI, based in Europe, and partners closely with US branch management in California. It is designed for someone who thrives with a high degree of autonomy and wants to shape team operations while driving innovative product development. **What you can expect** ======================= * Lead and mentor a distributed US team of 13 engineers across AI/ML, cloud backend, frontend, and DevOps. * Conduct regular 1:1s, manage performance, support career development, and foster a high\-trust, continuous\-learning team culture. * Drive the delivery cadence by proactively clearing blockers, planning milestones, and ensuring reliable execution. * Champion engineering excellence, including modern CI/CD, cloud automation, AI assistance, code reviews, monitoring, and documentation. * Serve as the primary operational link between the US engineering team and the leadership organization in Germany. * Partner closely with California branch management on HR, operational processes, and organizational alignment. * Participate credibly in architectural discussions across AI/ML pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and core software systems. * Identify delivery bottlenecks and implement lightweight processes that scale across international time zones. **What you bring** ================== **To become part of the Rosenxt family,** you have a collaborative, empathetic and technically credible way of working. You should also bring: * 7\+ years in software engineering, with 2\+ years managing cross\-disciplinary technical teams (software, AI/ML, and DevOps). * Strong technical background in at least one core area (AI/ML systems, cloud backend, or DevOps) with working fluency across the others. * Proven track record of hiring, coaching, performance management, and building psychological safety in remote or distributed environments. * Excellent cross\-cultural communication and stakeholder management skills across executive levels, time zones, and global sites. * Strong delivery management skills, including pragmatic prioritization, workload delegation, and trade\-off decision\-making. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or a related technical discipline. * Production experience with AI/ML systems or high\-reliability cloud and edge architectures (preferred). * Experience in regulated or safety\-critical industrial sectors, or familiarity with AI governance frameworks like the EU AI Act (preferred). **Look forward to** =================== * Development opportunities and career opportunities in a global, innovative and long\-term oriented group of companies with family character * Flexible working time, working time accounts and Home Office possible * An open, informal corporate culture, where we celebrate success with social events * Depending on the hiring location you may also benefit from local benefits More information about the Rosenxt Group please click here: www.rosen\-nxt.com

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Associate
jobs.description: **Position Details** -------------------- Position Information **Recruitment/Posting Title** Postdoctoral Associate **Job Category** Staff \& Executive \- Research (Laboratory/Non\-Laboratory) **Department** RWJ \- Neurosurgery **Overview** New Jersey’s academic health center, Rutgers Biomedical and Health Sciences (RBHS) takes an integrated approach to educating students, providing clinical care, and conducting research, all with the goal of improving human health. Aligned with Rutgers University–New Brunswick and collaborating university wide, RBHS includes eight schools, a behavioral health network, and six centers and institutes that focus on cancer treatment and research, neuroscience, clinical and translational research, advanced biotechnology and medicine, environmental and occupational health, and health care policy and aging research. Our faculty are teachers, clinicians, and scientists with unparalleled experience who advance medical innovation and provide patient care informed by the latest research findings. We offer an outstanding education in medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, public health, nursing, biomedical research, and the full spectrum of allied health careers. Our clinical and academic facilities are located throughout the state including New Brunswick, Piscataway, Newark, Scotch Plains, Somerset, Blackwood, and other locations. Clinical partners include Robert Wood Johnson University Hospital in New Brunswick, University Hospital in Newark, and other affiliates. Through this community of healers, scientists, and scholars, Rutgers is equipped as never before to transform lives. **Posting Summary** Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey invites applications for a Postdoctoral Associate position in the Neurosurgery Department, Robert Wood Johnson Medical School. Under the direction of the Principal Investigator, the Postdoctoral Associate will conduct translational epilepsy research focused on the network mechanisms of ictogenesis in mesial temporal lobe epilepsy (MTLE). The researcher will develop and validate quantitative, event\-driven intracranial EEG (iEEG) approaches to characterize the Epileptogenic Network (EpiNet) and identify network chokepoints involved in seizure initiation. The position integrates preclinical optogenetic and intrahippocampal kainic acid (IHKA) mouse models with retrospective human iEEG and therapeutic outcome data. Responsibilities include small\-animal surgery, multichannel electrophysiology, optogenetic and electrical stimulation, neuromodulation and lesion\-based validation, signal processing, computational network analysis, and dissemination of results. The postdoctoral associate will work with substantial independence, collaborate with clinicians, engineers, computational scientists, mentor junior trainees, contribute to manuscripts and grant applications, and develop toward an independent research program. Among the key duties of this position are the following: * Design and perform in vivo mouse experiments using optogenetic and intrahippocampal kainic acid (IHKA) models of mesial temporal lobe seizures/epilepsy, including stereotactic injections and implantation of multichannel recording and stimulation electrodes. * Acquire, curate, and analyze multichannel iEEG/electrophysiology recordings from preclinical models and retrospective human MTLE datasets. * Apply complex signal\-processing approaches to analyze animal and human intracranial EEG. * Develop and implement computational network analyses to characterize the brain network interactions using connectivity and graph theory metrics. * Develop reproducible computational pipelines in MATLAB, Python, R, or similar platforms for electrophysiology processing, network analysis, visualization, quality control, and statistical analysis. * Perform and analyze electrical neuromodulation experiments, including open\-loop and closed\-loop stimulation paradigms, to test whether novel neurostimulation paradigms can interrupt seizures. **FLSA** Exempt **Grade** **Salary Details** **Minimum Salary** 20,000 **Mid Range Salary** 90,000 **Maximum Salary** 200,000 **Offer Information** The final salary offer may be determined by several factors, including, but not limited to, the candidate’s qualifications, experience, and expertise, and availability of department or grant funds to support the position. We also take into consideration market benchmarks, if and when appropriate, and internal equity to ensure fair compensation relative to the university’s broader compensation structure. We are committed to offering competitive and flexible compensation packages to attract and retain top talent. **Benefits** Rutgers provides a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees. The specific benefits vary based on the position and may include: * Medical, prescription drug, and dental coverage * Paid vacation, holidays, and various leave programs * Competitive retirement benefits, including defined contribution plans collaboratively. * Excellent critical thinking and problem\-solving skills. * Outstanding presentation skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Prior postdoctoral experience is not required. * Relevant experience in neuroscience, electrophysiology, computational neuroscience, biomedical engineering, or preclinical research is preferred. * Proficient with scientific computing and data\-analysis software; experience with MATLAB, Python, R, or related platforms is strongly preferred. * Experience with intracranial EEG (iEEG/ECoG/SEEG) or multichannel animal electrophysiology. * Familiarity with epilepsy, seizure dynamics, ictogenesis, neuromodulation, or neural network analysis. * Experience with small\-animal stereotactic surgery, viral\-vector or intracranial injections, electrode implantation, optogenetics, or electrical stimulation. * Experience with Granger causality, effective connectivity, graph\-theoretical analysis, event\-triggered analysis, or related computational methods. * Track record of peer\-reviewed publications and interest in developing an independent research program **Equipment Utilized** **Physical Demands and Work Environment** * Physical Demands: Standing, sitting, walking, talking, and hearing. Experience working in a fast\-paced environment. Lab environment. Lifting to 25lbs. * Work Environment: Open office environment. Moderate noise and foot traffic. Rutgers University is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse, cooperative work environment. **Special Conditions** Posting Details **Posting Number** 26ST1842 **Posting Open Date** **Special Instructions to Applicants** **Regional Campus** Rutgers Biomedical and Health Sciences (RBHS) **Home Location Campus** Piscataway (RBHS) **City** Piscataway **State** NJ **Location Details** Pre\-employment Screenings All offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of all pre\-employment screenings. Immunization Requirements Under Policy 100\.3\.1 Immunization Policy for Covered Individuals, if employment will commence during Flu Season, Rutgers University may require certain prospective employees to provide proof that they are vaccinated against Seasonal Influenza for the current Flu Season, unless the University has granted the individual a medical or religious exemption. Additional infection control and safety policies may apply. Prospective employees should speak with their hiring manager to determine which policies apply to the role or position for which they are applying. Failure to provide proof of vaccination for any required vaccines or obtain a medical or religious exemption from the University will result in rescission of a candidate’s offer of employment or disciplinary action up to and including termination. Equal Employment Opportunity Statement It is university policy to provide equal employment opportunity to all its employees and applicants for employment regardless of their race, creed, color, national origin, age, ancestry, nationality, marital or domestic partnership or civil union status, sex, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, disability status, liability for military service, protected veteran status, affectional or sexual orientation, atypical cellular or blood trait, genetic information (including the refusal to submit to genetic testing), or any other category protected by law. As an institution, we encourage all qualified applicants to apply. For additional information please see the Non\-Discrimination Statement at the following web address: http://uhr.rutgers.edu/non\-discrimination\-statement **Supplemental Questions** -------------------------- Required fields are indicated with an asterisk (\*). * Do you have a PhD, MD, or equivalent doctoral degree in Neuroscience, Biomedical Engineering, Psychology, Computer Science, or a related field? * Yes * No **Applicant Documents** ----------------------- **Required Documents** * Resume/CV **Optional Documents** * Cover Letter/Letter of Application

jobs.title: Structural Designer
jobs.description: Overview: Within SSOE's Tool Install division, we specialize in the design and engineering of complex process equipment across semiconductor fabs and advanced manufacturing facilities. Our structural team plays a critical role in ensuring that every tool installation is built on a foundation of precision, safety, and technical excellence, from equipment support structures and seismic bracing to subfab framing and cleanroom modifications. Our structural designers work together with multi\-discipline teams including mechanical, electrical, and process engineers to deliver fully integrated, installation\-ready designs that meet our client’s and industry standards. The **Structural Designer** supports the planning and delivery of complex process equipment installations in semiconductor fabrication facilities, helping translate equipment and facility requirements into clear, constructible structural design packages. This role prepares and coordinates layouts, calculations, and details for tool support structures, subfab racks, lateral supports, embeds, platforms, and related facility modifications while working closely with project managers, structural and mechanical discipline leads. The designer evaluates loads, access, tolerances, and installation constraints, incorporates safety and code requirements, and helps manage design changes through review and approval gates. Strong attention to detail, coordination, and responsiveness are essential to support successful design execution, field installation, and startup. AI and Innovation: At SSOE, we don’t just talk about the future, we build it. As a leader in industry AI adoption, we empower our team to work smarter by providing responsible access to the industry leading AI Large Language Models, vibe\-coding platforms, and securely integrating advanced tools into every role. From day one, you’ll receive the training and support needed to leverage AI as a core tool for enhancing productivity, sparking creativity, and streamlining complex workflows. Responsibilities: * Develop structural design deliverables for process tool installation projects, including layouts, plans, sections, details, and supporting documentation for tool supports, racks, platforms, embeds, and associated facility modifications. * Coordinate with mechanical, electrical, and architectural disciplines to align structural design with equipment footprints, utility routing, seismic and support requirements, access clearances, and installation sequencing. * Perform or support structural calculations for equipment loads, point loads, anchorage, support framing, and other project\-specific design conditions, ensuring compliance with applicable codes, standards, and client criteria. * Prepare design packages from concept through construction issue, incorporating constructability, maintainability, access, and safety considerations for cleanroom, subfab, and support spaces. * Review vendor equipment data, installation requirements, and interface documents to identify design impacts, resolve conflicts, and confirm structural support needs. * Participate in design reviews, model reviews, and coordination meetings with internal teams, clients, and contractors to support scope alignment, design quality, and schedule execution. * Support QA/QC processes by checking drawings, calculations, and models for accuracy, completeness, code compliance, and consistency across disciplines. * Track and incorporate design changes, field conditions, and client comments through formal change control and revision management processes. * Help identify project risks related to structural support, schedule, constructability, or field installation and communicate mitigation needs to project leadership. * Maintain clear and professional communication with clients, contractors, and internal stakeholders to support smooth coordination and timely issue resolution. * Contribute to a culture of safety by incorporating safe access, installation sequencing, and fieldwork considerations into design decisions and project reviews. Qualifications: * High school diploma or GED is required. An Associate’s degree\-tracked in Structural or Civil engineering technology is preferred. * Experience in structural design or drafting, preferably in an industrial, semiconductor, or advanced manufacturing environment. * Experience with structural design software such as RISA, RAM, or similar platforms is a plus. * Proficiency with AutoCAD and Revit, with the ability to produce coordinated, construction\-ready structural documents. * Ability to conduct field verifications and site assessments to identify, verify, resolve, and integrate solutions into design packages, troubleshooting design issues during construction as necessary. * Experience with or exposure to semiconductor fab environments, cleanroom construction, or process equipment installation is a strong plus. * Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple deliverables in a schedule\-driven project environment. * Ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines and communicate clearly with engineers, project managers, and contractors. * Ability to mentor junior team members or support peer review processes as project needs require. * Salary Range: $50,000 \- $100,000/year depending on location, education, depth of relevant experience, and any specialized licensure/certifications. Opportunity for ample rewards, leadership incentive components, and generous bonus opportunities. * Benefits: Includes comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, life insurance, 401K retirement savings plan (with company matching), opportunities for professional development and training (including support for relevant licensure \& certifications), and generous PTO \& paid holidays. Join us at SSOE, where your expertise will thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment dedicated to pushing the boundaries of design and engineering excellence. If you're passionate about innovation and eager to make a significant impact, we invite you to apply and become a part of our forward\-thinking team. \#LI\-Hybrid
