jobs.title: System Engineer Level 5
jobs.description: Steel Point Solutions is an amazing SBA Certified (8a), HUBZone, Small Disadvantaged Business (SDB) and a Woman Owned Small Business (WOSB) company. Established in 2013 with a vision of offering world class, integrated business solutions for all levels of Government and commercial enterprises. We are represented by a team of talented and qualified professionals who know how essential efficient, cost\-effective integrated solutions are to your organization's success. Leveraging these resources, we strive daily to lead the industry in program management and service delivery. **Role Summary** The System Engineer applies systems engineering principles throughout the systems life cycle phases: Concept, Development, Production, Utilization, Support, and Retirement. Interacts with the Government regarding Systems Engineering technical considerations and for associated problems, issues or conflicts. Communicate with other program personnel, government overseers, and senior executives. Responsible for the technical integrity, quality, and completeness of work performed and deliverables associated with one or more of the 25 process areas defined by ISO/IEC15288: * **Technical Process Area** \- Stakeholder Requirements Definition, Requirements Analysis, Architectural Design, Implementation, Integration, Verification, Transition, Validation, Operation, Maintenance, and Disposal * **Project Process Area** \- Project Planning, Project Assessment and Control, Decision Management, Risk Management, Configuration Management, Information Management, and Measurement * **Enterprise (Organizational Project\-Enabling) Process Area** \- Project Portfolio Management, Infrastructure Management, Lifecycle Model Management, Human Resource Management, and Quality Management * **Agreement Process Area** \- Acquisition and Supply. **Key Responsibilities** The System Engineer shall possess the following capabilities: * Perform systems engineering activities and assist in the preparation of a work product in Technical Process Areas associated with the ISO/IEC 15288\. * Perform systems engineering activities and assist in the preparation of multiple work products in Project and/or Technical Process Areas associated with any of the ISO/IEC 15288 processes. * Assist in performing systems engineering activities in the ISO/IEC 15288 Agreement or Enterprise Process Areas. * Perform analysis of technical alternatives for a project and make preliminary recommendations. * Develop and deliver a work product in any of the ISO/IEC 15288 Process Areas. * Perform systems engineering activities and develop and deliver work products of either the ISO/IEC 15288 Agreement or Enterprise Process Areas. * Independently analyze and recommend alternatives for elements of project's technical design. * Perform systems engineering activities and develop and deliver work products in each of the ISO/IEC 15288 Project and Technical Process Areas. * Supervise or coordinate the work of other contractor engineers or technicians on a project. * Analyze and propose appropriate engineering standards and processes for a project. * Assist in conducting an evaluation to determine its suitability for project implementation. * Assist in developing a new or innovative approach to a technical or engineering issue. * Brief stakeholders and present the status on all technical aspects of their project. * Independently make decisions regarding engineering issues and methodology for a project. * Approve delivery of work products of multiple Processes Areas defined in the ISO/IEC 15288\. * Lead contractor systems engineering activities for a project to include supervising the work of the project engineering staff and technicians. **Required Qualifications** * High School Diploma or GED plus nineteen (19\) years of general systems engineering experience * Bachelor's degree in Aeronautics, Biomedical, Chemical, Civil, Computer, Electrical, Environmental, Mechanical, Nuclear, Software, Systems, Engineering Management or a related discipline plus fifteen (15\) years of systems engineering experience * Master's degree in Aeronautics, Biomedical, Chemical, Civil, Computer, Electrical, Environmental, Mechanical, Nuclear, Software, Systems, Engineering Management or a related discipline plus thirteen (13\) years of systems engineering experience. * PhD in Aeronautics, Biomedical, Chemical, Civil, Computer, Electrical, Environmental, Mechanical, Nuclear, Software, Systems, Engineering Management or a related discipline plus thirteen (13\) years of systems engineering experience. **Candidates from Historically Underutilized Business Zones (HUBZone) are strongly encouraged to apply. To determine whether you reside in a HUBZone, visit: https://maps.certify.sba.gov/hubzone/map.**

jobs.title: Data Engineer I
jobs.description: **Join our growing team and discover why Summit Utilities, Inc. continues to earn national and regional recognition as an employer of choice. Our recognitions include Best Places to Work in Maine (2019–2025\); Best Places to Work in Arkansas (2020, 2023, 2025\); Best Places to Work in Oklahoma (2022–2025\); Best Places to Work in Missouri (2023 and 2026\); Best Places to Work in Colorado (2025\); Forbes America’s Best Small Employers (2023\); and, most recently, Proud and Purposeful Employer (2026\).** Summit is a growing natural gas utility providing safe, reliable, and clean burning natural gas service to homes and businesses in Arkansas, Colorado, Maine, Missouri, Oklahoma, and Texas. Being part of the Summit team means embracing excellence and innovation, committing to safety each and every day, and doing all that we can to serve each other, our customers, and the communities where we live. We aim to bring warmth and energy to everything we do. **We have an exciting opportunity for a a Data Engineer I (SGL17\). This hybrid role can be based in one of our offices in Fort Smith, Fayetteville, or Little Rock, Arkansas.** **POSITION SUMMARY** Summit Utilities is seeking a **Data Engineer I** to support the development, maintenance, and enhancement of enterprise data pipelines and integration solutions. This entry\-level engineering role is ideal for professionals with foundational experience in data systems and a strong interest in growing their expertise within a collaborative, enterprise\-scale environment. The Data Engineer I works closely with senior engineers, analysts, and database administrators to implement and support reliable data solutions across platforms. Ideal candidates have 1–3 years of experience with ETL development, SQL scripting, and modern data integration practices, along with a demonstrated sense of ownership, curiosity, and attention to detail when working with complex data environments. **PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Build and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines and integration workflows using modern orchestration tools, low\-code platforms, and custom scripting across on\-prem and cloud systems. * Ingest, transform, and stage structured and semi\-structured data into enterprise data repositories, including writing, troubleshooting, and optimizing SQL queries, views, and stored procedures. * Support data quality and reliability by implementing validation checks, alerts, logging, and monitoring, and by partnering with Data Analysts and SAP Analysts to validate datasets and confirm accurate delivery. * Document data sources, pipeline logic, and transformations in shared repositories, and manage code through team\-based source control and code review practices. * Participate in standups, sprint planning, and on\-call rotations, responding to data support tickets and identifying opportunities to improve processes and adopt new technologies. **EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered. * 1–3 years of experience in data engineering, ETL development, or data integration roles * Experience building or maintaining data pipelines using orchestration tools and/or custom scripting. * Practical experience with relational databases, including writing and tuning SQL, plus exposure to cloud\-based data environments and collaborative source control. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES** * Working knowledge of modern data orchestration and workflow automation tools, including building pipelines with both low\-code platforms and custom code * Solid understanding of relational databases with the ability to write and debug T\-SQL or PL/SQL; exposure to cloud data engineering concepts preferred. * Understanding of data integration concepts, including file transfers (FTP/SFTP), API\-based ingestion, data staging, source control, and deployment automation * Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills with attention to data accuracy and reliability, and the ability to document processes, logic flows, and system configurations clearly. * Effective verbal and written communication with analysts, engineers, and stakeholders; self\-motivated, team\-oriented, and aligned with PEAKS values and organizational goals. The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and/or skills required of all personnel so classified. Summit offers competitive pay and medical/dental/vision and other benefits that provide flexibility, choice, and support to our employees when they need it most. We understand that home and family are essential pieces of your life, and our benefits are designed to support you both at work and at home. Summit Utilities, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability or veteran status.

jobs.title: Industrial Engineer – Solar Operations & Data Analytics
jobs.description: **Industrial Engineer – Solar Operations \& Data Analytics** ------------------------------------------------------------ **Job Level:** Individual Contributor **Location:** Orem, Utah **Shift:** Full\-Time **Compensation:** $100,000–$120,000 ### **About SunPower** SunPower's mission is to provide industry leading, innovative, end\-to\-end solar energy solutions with exceptional customer service. With over 30 years of experience in the US Residential Solar industry, we deliver an all\-in\-one solar solution that supports the transition to clean energy. SunPower continues to grow through the strategic asset and company acquisitions of leading solar companies. Some recent examples include acquiring strategic assets of the former SunPower Corporation and Blue Raven Solar as well as the acquisition of Sunder Energy, Ambia Energy, and Cobalt Power. These transitions bring together the strengths, expertise, and shared commitment to making clean energy simpler and more accessible for everyone. ### **Benefits** * Employee RSU Awards program * Quarterly \& Annual bonus program (based on performance) * Competitive coverage for Health, Dental, and Vision insurance * PTO/DTO for full\-time employees * 10 paid holidays * Fully stocked breakroom with snacks, drinks, breakfast, and company provided lunch once a week! * Ping pong and Corn hole in office * CanyonPark Perks: Access to a gym, pickleball \& basketball courts, outside patio areas, food trucks, and more! ### **Position Summary** We are seeking a highly analytical Industrial Engineer / Operations Analyst to improve the performance, productivity, and scalability of our solar operations. This role will analyze operational data across the solar project lifecycle—from sales and design through permitting, installation, inspection, PTO, and activation—and turn that data into actionable insights for Operations and leadership. The ideal candidate enjoys working with data, understands operational processes, and can build dashboards, charts, reports, and performance\-management tools that clearly show where the business is performing well and where it is getting stuck. This is a hands\-on role for someone who can move between data, systems, processes, and people and help create a data\-driven operating culture. ### **Essential Duties** * Analyze data across the solar project lifecycle to identify bottlenecks, delays, productivity issues, and opportunities for improvement. * Track project flow from sale through design, permitting, installation, inspection, PTO, and activation. * Analyze cycle times, aging, work in progress (WIP), productivity, backlog, throughput, conversion rates, cancellations, rework, revenue, and MW throughput. * Identify where projects are accumulating in the pipeline, perform root\-cause analysis, and determine the operational and financial impact of delays. * Develop operational benchmarks and identify performance gaps across teams, markets, crews, and regions. * Build and maintain dashboards that provide real\-time or near\-real\-time visibility into project pipeline, backlog and aging, cycle times, quality, inspection pass rates, PTO, installer/crew productivity, regional performance, forecast vs. actual production, and operational constraints. * Design reporting for both front\-line managers and executive leadership, with the most important issues immediately visible. * Map and analyze operational workflows and recommend process changes that improve speed, quality, customer experience, and profitability. * Support continuous\-improvement initiatives across Operations, Design, Construction, Supply Chain, and Customer Experience. * Establish standard operating metrics and definitions across teams and track the impact of improvement initiatives. * Extract, clean, combine, and analyze data from CRM, project management, ERP, design, installation, and other operational systems. * Develop a consistent source of truth for key operational metrics and partner with IT/Data teams to improve data quality and reporting infrastructure. * Automate data collection and recurring reporting to reduce reliance on manual spreadsheets. ### **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Operations, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. * 2–5\+ years of experience in operations analytics, industrial engineering, business intelligence, project operations, process improvement, or a similar analytical role. * Experience working with large operational datasets. * Strong Excel skills, including PivotTables, Power Query, formulas, and data visualization. * Demonstrated experience building Power BI, Tableau, or similar dashboards. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with the ability to identify patterns in data and translate them into business actions. * Strong communication skills and ability to work with both technical and non\-technical teams. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in solar, energy, construction, home services, telecommunications, logistics, or another project\-based operational business. * Experience with Salesforce or other CRM platforms, SQL, Power BI or Tableau, and Python or other data\-analysis tools. * Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, process improvement, or operational excellence. * Experience analyzing field\-service or installation operations. * Understanding of project lifecycle management and WIP management. ### **Success in the Role** Success will be measured by the ability to create clear operational visibility and measurable improvement across the solar business, including reduced project cycle times, WIP and aging; increased throughput and installation productivity; improved design and installation quality; reduced rework and cancellations; improved forecast accuracy; increased operational capacity without proportional increases in headcount; automated management reporting; and creation of a consistent, data\-driven operating rhythm. ### **Ideal Candidate Profile** Data analyst \+ Industrial Engineer \+ Operations problem solver. We do not require a traditional Industrial Engineering background. We care more about whether the candidate can understand a complex operational process, work with data, build excellent dashboards, find the problem, help the organization fix it, and measure whether the corrective action improved performance. Solar experience is a plus, but strong analytical and operational experience in another project\-based industry can also be highly successful in this role.

jobs.title: Data Engineer, Finance
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Hub \- San Francisco; Hub \- Seattle **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Engineering, Product, Design, and MarketingEngineeringDataData/Analytics Engineer *Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in\-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.* *Preferred locations for team members for our Data Platform roles are our San Francisco or Seattle hubs.* **About Superhuman** -------------------- Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company's products include Grammarly's writing assistance, Docs’ collaborative workspace, Mail's inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here. **The Opportunity** Want to build the data foundations behind how Superhuman measures and grows its business? As a Data Engineer on the **Finance \& Revenue** team, you’ll own the pipelines, models, and datasets that power revenue reporting across Superhuman’s AI\-native productivity platform: Grammarly’s writing assistance, Mail, Docs, Databases, and Go. You’ll partner closely with Finance, Revenue Operations, Analytics, and Engineering to turn billing, bookings, customer, and product\-usage signals into reliable, decision\-grade data. Superhuman is a compound startup: we build many products as one integrated suite rather than standalone tools. That model creates an unusually rich and complex revenue data opportunity, with signals spanning billing systems, self\-serve and enterprise motions, and cross\-product customer usage. The data you model connects those surfaces to create a unified view of ARR, NRR, bookings, and revenue performance across the Superhuman Suite. This is a high\-ownership, high\-impact role at the intersection of data engineering, finance, and business strategy. You’ll own revenue\-critical systems end\-to\-end and contribute to the revenue attribution model, ensuring the company’s most visible financial datasets are precise, accessible, and trusted. Your work will directly shape how leadership understands business performance and makes investment decisions. **What you’ll do** * Design, build, and own scalable data pipelines (Spark/Databricks) that ingest and model billing, subscription, payment, and bookings data across the Superhuman Suite. * Build and maintain the foundational datasets for ARR, NRR, bookings, and other revenue metrics, ensuring the company has a consistent, trusted view of financial performance. * Contribute to the revenue attribution model by building and maintaining the underlying datasets that connect product usage, customer lifecycle, and commercial signals into an explainable view of business performance. * Model revenue data into clean, well\-documented, reusable tables that Finance, Revenue Operations, analysts, and business partners can self\-serve from. * Own data quality, freshness, and reliability for revenue\-critical datasets, with automated checks, monitoring, alerting, and reconciliation processes. * Partner with Finance, Revenue Operations, Analytics Engineering, Product, and Engineering to translate business questions into robust data models and trustworthy metrics. * Continuously improve the performance, cost efficiency, and developer experience of our finance and revenue data platform. You’ll do this alongside partners across Finance, Revenue Operations, Analytics Engineering, Product, and Engineering. We think from first principles, challenging the familiar to reframe problems and reach sharper solutions, and win with grit, staying with the hardest problems through the messy middle. You’ll have the freedom to own your systems and directly influence the roadmap, and the complexity of what you build will grow quickly as we scale. **Qualifications** ------------------ * You have 3\+ years of experience building and operating production data pipelines and data platforms, ideally supporting finance, revenue, billing, or other business\-critical analytical use cases. * You’re highly proficient in SQL and have strong data engineering foundations, with hands\-on experience in Spark and a modern lakehouse or cloud data warehouse (Databricks, Delta Lake, dbt, Snowflake, or similar). * You have strong data modeling and data warehouse design skills, with the ability to transform complex business processes and source\-system data into clear, reliable, and reusable datasets. * You bring a rigorous approach to data quality, precision, observability, and reconciliation, especially for datasets used in revenue reporting and business decisions. * You have experience with workflow orchestration and CI/CD for data (for example, Databricks Workflows or Airflow, with Git\-based deployment). * You’re comfortable using AI\-assisted development tools like Codex or Claude Code to move faster, and you have the judgment to validate and supervise their output. * You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with business partners, analysts, engineers, and leadership, translating smoothly between technical and business audiences. * You care about business impact and enjoy turning ambiguous finance and revenue questions into reliable, scalable data products and trustworthy metrics. * You’re a self\-starting problem\-solver who thinks from first principles, manages priorities across multiple projects, and thrives in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment. ### **Nice to have** * Direct experience supporting Finance, Revenue Operations, or revenue analytics, including metrics such as ARR, NRR, bookings, billing, or revenue attribution. * Experience ingesting or modeling data from Stripe or similar billing, payments, ERP, or subscription\-management systems. * Experience working with product\-usage data, usage\-based billing, or attribution models. * A track record of building well\-documented, self\-serve data products that business and analytics teams rely on. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing the following and more: * Excellent health care (including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and fertility benefits) * Disability and life insurance options * 401(k) matching * Paid parental leave * 20 days of paid time off per year, 12 days of paid holidays per year, two floating holidays per year, and flexible sick time * Generous stipends (including those for caregiving, pet care, wellness, your home office, and more) * Annual professional development budget and opportunities Superhuman takes a market\-based approach to compensation, which means base pay may vary depending on your location. Our US locations are categorized into two compensation zones based on proximity to our hub locations. Base pay may vary considerably depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The expected salary ranges for this position are outlined below by compensation zone and may be modified in the future. ### **US Zone 1** 175,000 to 245,000 ### **US Zone 2** 157,000 to 220,500 **We encourage you to apply** ----------------------------- At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, political belief, or any other characteristic protected by law. Superhuman is an equal opportunity employer and a participant in the US federal E\-Verify program (US). We also abide by the Employment Equity Act (Canada).

jobs.title: Sr. ML Engineer, Network Intelligence
jobs.description: **What to Expect** You'll own the AI system behind an internal platform that investigates infrastructure problems using real\-time telemetry, metrics, and logs from thousands of devices. This isn't a chatbot wrapper or an API integration. You run the models on our own GPUs: serving, fine\-tuning, evaluating, and pushing them to work reliably in production. You'll be an early member of a small team where you make the architecture calls and ship to real users. When something breaks in the network, your system is what engineers turn to for answers. **What You'll Do*** Get LLM inference fast and reliable in production. Quantization, tensor parallelism, batching, KV cache tuning, speculative decoding and figuring out why the GPU is only hitting 3 tok/s when it should do 18 * Build the agent loop, the system where the model calls tools, gathers data from monitoring systems step by step, pieces together what happened, and writes a diagnostic report. Handle the messy parts: retries, timeouts, dedup, context limits * Build investigation tools that the agent calls: structured playbooks that query metrics databases, search logs, check alerts, and apply domain specific checks (threshold comparisons, decision trees, event correlation) * Fine tune models on real investigation traces. Curate training data from production, not synthetic benchmarks. Design evals that measure whether the diagnosis is actually correct, not just whether the loss went down * Own the GPU infrastructure. Multi node clusters, Ray, Docker, K8s. Model versioning. Know when to serve on one GPU vs four, and why the answer changes depending on the model architecture * Build background agents that watch telemetry continuously and flag problems before anyone asks Not dashboards but agents that reason about what they see * Build retrieval over operational runbooks and past incidents so the model has context beyond what's in the metrics * Work with the network engineering team to understand how they actually troubleshoot, and turn that methodology into tools and evaluation criteria the model can use **What You'll Bring*** 4\+ years building ML systems that run in production. Not notebooks, not demos, systems that serve real users and break in interesting ways * Serve LLMs in production using vLLM, TGI, TensorRT\-LLM, or something comparable. You know that decode speed comes down to memory bandwidth, and you've had to debug why * Understand transformers beyond the abstractions: attention, KV caches, rotary embeddings, GQA, what quantization actually does to the weights and when it matters * Solid Python engineering. FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes. Your code gets reviewed and deployed, not run once in a notebook * Read model source code (PyTorch, HF Transformers) and debug at the CUDA level when the serving stack does something unexpected * GradientLoom or similar frameworks for extracting structured training data from production logs * Fine tuned models with LoRA, QLoRA, full SFT and dealt with the harder parts: what training data to collect, how to evaluate quality, and how to merge adapters without regressing * Experience building agent or tool calling systems. Tool schemas, multi turn state, models that ignore instructions, evaluating end\-to\-end quality #### **Benefits** Along with competitive pay, as a full\-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire: * Medical plans \> plan options with $0 payroll deduction * Family\-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits * Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution * Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High\-Deductible medical plan with HSA * Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits * Company paid Basic Life, AD\&D * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period) * Employee Assistance Program * Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays * Back\-up childcare and parenting support resources * Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft \& legal services, and pet insurance * Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs * Tesla Babies program * Commuter benefits * Employee discounts and perks program #### **Expected Compensation** $124,000 \- $396,000/annual salary \+ cash and stock awards \+ benefits Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. jobs.title: Validation Engineer, Industrial Energy Products
jobs.description: **What to Expect** We are seeking a validation engineer for the site\-level energy controller on our utility\-scale battery sites. That controller runs on embedded Linux. It manages settings, telemetry, and failover, and it talks to utility and SCADA equipment. You will run software\-centric SIL and HIL for it, build that regression with System Integration, and keep the work on the bench. You do not need to have already defined a validation program. You do need the instinct to look at a controller change and suspect which failure would escape, then go prove it. Our stack includes Go, Rust, and Python. We are language agnostic, and none of these is mandatory. **What You'll Do*** Run software\-centric SIL and HIL for the site\-level energy controller on embedded Linux — settings, telemetry, redundancy/failover, and utility/SCADA communications — so System Integration is testing the site, not the application * Propose the cases worth automating. For a controller change, look for the failures that would escape — restarts, partial writes, timed\-out peers, split state — and do not stop at a suite that only proves the happy path. System Integration and the software team decide which of those become permanent tests * Build that regression with System Integration: automated SIL and HIL that runs against controller builds and catches those cases before they become a system\-test problem. The team writes these tests in pytest * Validate Modbus, DNP3, and SCADA behavior on the bench, including timeouts, bad frames, and peer dropouts, on real equipment where the lab has it and in simulation where it does not * Debug the bench you share. You will not own rack bring\-up, but you will trace a failure from the application through TCP/IP to the port, and you will touch the hardware when that is the fastest way to separate a software bug from a wiring one * When the defect is below the application, follow it far enough to hand off a reproducible case. Kernel and OS depth is learned here. The work stays on the bench: no field deployments, no full\-site signoff **What You'll Bring*** Degree in Engineering (Software, Electrical, Computer, or a related field), or equivalent experience * Internship, co\-op, or up to a few years in test, embedded software, or controls. A new graduate with a strong lab or project record qualifies. Five years is not required * Evidence you think about how something fails, not only how to show it works. A project or internship where you found a case the obvious test missed * Some time on a bench, in SIL, or in HIL. You have written or changed a test, not only run one someone else wrote * Networking fundamentals enough to follow a conversation from the application toward the wire, and a willingness to debug on real hardware * One industrial protocol, or proof you can pick an unfamiliar one up quickly. Modbus, DNP3, or SCADA. All three is not required * Able to read code and change a test harness. Our stack includes Go, Rust, and Python. We are language agnostic, and none of these is mandatory * Able to write automated tests. We use pytest. Experience in another framework is fine * Kernel or OS debugging is not required #### **Benefits** Along with competitive pay, as a full\-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire: * Medical plans \> plan options with $0 payroll deduction * Family\-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits * Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution * Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High\-Deductible medical plan with HSA * Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits * Company paid Basic Life, AD\&D * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period) * Employee Assistance Program * Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays * Back\-up childcare and parenting support resources * Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft \& legal services, and pet insurance * Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs * Tesla Babies program * Commuter benefits * Employee discounts and perks program #### **Expected Compensation** $120,000 \- $252,000/annual salary \+ cash and stock awards \+ benefits Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. jobs.title: Professor / Associate Professor in Human-Centered Embodied Artificial Intelligence (Robotics)
jobs.description: **Mission Statement** --------------------- At Michigan Engineering, we develop people\-first engineers who will shape the world for the better. Through discovery and innovation, we create the foundational knowledge and practical technologies that address today's pressing challenges, power industries, and change lives. Our programs and community are designed to promote personal well\-being and achievement, enabling everyone to unlock their potential and contribute with confidence. **Job Summary** --------------- The Robotics Department in the College of Engineering at the University of Michigan, Ann Arbor invites applications for one senior (tenure\-track or tenured) faculty position in Human\-Centered Artificial Intelligence, offered through the University of Michigan Faculty Expansion Program. The successful candidate will join our mission to accelerate advances in robotics for the benefit of society. Candidates will have a relevant doctorate or equivalent experience and an outstanding record of achievement and impactful research in academia, industry, and/or at national laboratories. They will have a strong record of commitment to teaching and mentorship at the undergraduate and graduate levels and to providing service to the university and to the profession. Rank is commensurate with experience, from promotion\-ready assistant professor through full professor. We seek an outstanding scholar whose work advances the theory and practice of AI\-driven embodied systems that collaborate with humans in physical environments. This position is a cornerstone of a broader university initiative in Human\-Centered and Human\-Embodied AI (HCAI). This position will reside in the Robotics Department, with the intention of strengthening synergies with the School of Information and the potential to seed a future multi\-unit research center. The position supports the University's Vision 2034 strategic priorities, which emphasize impactful research in health, education, sustainability, and human\-centered technology. An ideal candidate will bring a demonstrated record of expertise and scholarship that is deeply connected to leading robotics and AI research, student engagement and experiential learning, and the values of the Robotics Department. Research contributions are expected to focus on developing responsible embodied AI systems for seamless human collaboration in physical environments, for areas including AI alignment, human\-robot interaction, foundational models, collaborative robotics, multimodal interaction, AR/VR interfaces, and cognitive models of human\-AI joint action. A successful candidate will be expected to develop a vigorous, externally funded research program in human\-centered and human\-embodied AI. Please see application instructions and further information at https://robotics.umich.edu/jobs/. Application review will begin on November 1, 2026 and will continue on a rolling basis. All applications submitted by December 15, 2026 will receive full consideration. If you have any questions regarding the search process, please contact robotics\-faculty\-search@umich.edu. The University of Michigan is one of the world's leading research universities, with $2\.16B in research expenditures (FY2025\). Consistently ranked among the top research universities by US News and NSF, it has 19 schools and colleges, and the University is rich with opportunities for collaboration and cross\-disciplinary inquiry. The successful candidate will have access to Michigan's advanced robotics facilities and resources, opportunities to contribute to emerging research center development and industry partnerships, and support for technology transfer, spinoff companies, and licensable innovations. We are located in Ann Arbor, MI, which is ranked the \#1 U.S. City for Quality of Life by U.S. News and World Report (2024\), \#2 City with the Best Public Schools in America by Niche.com (2021\), and \#1 Best Places to Live for Families by Fortune (2022\). Employment will require a criminal background check and may require an institutional reference check regarding any misconduct. If an institutional reference check is necessary, candidates will be required to submit a self\-disclosure form as well as an authorization to release information form. The University of Michigan is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. **Required Qualifications\*** ----------------------------- * A relevant doctorate or equivalent experience. * An outstanding record of achievement and impactful research in academia, industry, and/or at national laboratories. * A strong record of commitment to teaching and mentorship at the undergraduate and graduate levels. * A strong record of providing service to the university and to the profession. * Demonstrated experience and rank commensurate with a promotion\-ready assistant professor through full professor level. **Modes of Work** ----------------- Positions that are eligible for hybrid or mobile/remote work mode are at the discretion of the hiring department. Work agreements are reviewed annually at a minimum and are subject to change at any time, and for any reason, throughout the course of employment. Learn more about the work modes. **Underfill Statement** ----------------------- This position is posted as Associate Professor/Professor. The rank of the selected candidate will depend upon the candidate's qualifications. **U\-M EEO Statement** ---------------------- The University of Michigan is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Packaging Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** Tone Products is a fast\-growing syrup and sauce co\-packer in Melrose Park. The Packaging Quality Engineer keeps our filling lines running by solving packaging component problems at the source. When a cap leaks, a bottle arrives out of spec, a poly bag tears, or a label flags, this role finds the root cause, works the fix with the supplier, and makes sure the specification on file keeps it from happening again. The role sits in Supply Chain and Procurement, reports to the Director of Supply Chain, and works closely with Quality Assurance, Operations, and Engineering. About 60 percent of the job is floor troubleshooting and supplier quality. The other 40 percent is supply chain efficiency, including cost savings, pallet optimization, and line trials. This is not a structural or creative packaging design role. **Core Responsibilities** **1\. Line Troubleshooting \& Root Cause Analysis** * Respond to packaging component failures on automated liquid filling lines, including leaking caps, out\-of\-spec bottles, tearing poly bags, and flagging labels. * Lead root cause investigations using structured tools such as 5 Why, fishbone diagrams, and 8D. * Document findings and confirm that corrective actions hold. * Track packaging\-related downtime and defects to identify repeat issues. **2\. Specifications \& Material Data** * Own, acquire, and maintain the facility’s master technical specification library for all packaging items. * Secure current engineering drawings, critical tolerances, Material Data Sheets (MDS), and food contact compliance documentation from suppliers. * Use these documents as our “Golden Standards” for every packaging item. * Bring outdated specifications up to date, starting with the highest\-volume and highest\-risk items. **3\. Supplier Quality \& Vendor Accountability** * Author technical Non\-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and manage supplier Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs) through closure. * Provide the technical data Procurement needs to hold vendors accountable and secure material credits. * Support supplier qualification and audits, and review supplier certificates of analysis and compliance. * Report supplier quality performance to Procurement and Quality Assurance. **4\. Inbound Inspection Standards** * Translate specification sheets into clear, measurable inbound inspection criteria and sampling plans for the QA and receiving teams. * Train QA and receiving staff on inspection methods and measurement tools. * Partner with Quality Assurance so inspection standards fit the facility’s food safety program. **5\. Cost Savings \& Value Engineering** * Identify opportunities for material cost reductions, down\-gauging, or material consolidation. * Protect product quality and line efficiency while reducing cost. **6\. Logistics \& Pallet Optimization** * Review and optimize pallet configurations, shipper designs, and load stability. * Reduce freight damage and maximize warehouse space. **7\. Line Trials \& Qualification** * Plan and execute line trials for alternative packaging materials or new vendors sourced by Procurement. * Set acceptance criteria and document results before a new material is approved for production. **Technical Proficiencies** **Required** · Strong technical knowledge of rigid plastics (PET and HDPE bottles, closures, thread types) · Strong technical knowledge of flexible materials (poly bags, pouches, corrugated boxes, pressure\-sensitive labels) · Ability to read engineering drawings and blueprints, including tolerances · Ability to use precision measurement tools (calipers, micrometers, torque testers) · Root cause analysis tools (5 Why, fishbone, 8D) · Ability to write NCRs and manage supplier CAPAs · Working knowledge of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and data analysis in Excel · Excellent verbal and written communication skills in a manufacturing environment **Preferred** · Experience in food and beverage, CPG, or contract packaging · Familiarity with GMP, SQF, or BRC food safety programs and food contact packaging requirements · Experience with pallet optimization software (TOPS, CAPE) · Six Sigma Green Belt or ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) · Experience with ERP systems · Bilingual English/Spanish **Key Soft Skills** **Cross\-Functional Communication** Translates technical material issues into clear, actionable feedback for Procurement, Quality, Operations, and outside vendors. Explains what failed, why it matters, and what needs to change. **Analytical Problem\-Solving** Traces recurring packaging failures back to a root cause and supports each finding with measurements and data. **Vendor Accountability** Holds suppliers to the agreed specification using facts and documentation. Works with Procurement to secure corrective actions and material credits when materials miss the mark. **Hands\-On Floor Presence** Comfortable working directly on the production line with operators, supervisors, and maintenance to diagnose packaging problems as they happen. **Detail Oriented** Accuracy in specifications, tolerances, and measurements is essential. The specification library is only useful if it is correct and current. **Qualifications** **Required** * 3 or more years of packaging quality, supplier quality, supply chain engineering, or technical operations experience in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment. * Bachelor’s Degree in Packaging Science, Quality Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related technical field. Equivalent hands\-on experience will be considered. * Hands\-on experience reading engineering drawings and using precision measurement tools. * Experience writing non\-conformance reports and working with suppliers on corrective actions. **Preferred** * Food and beverage, CPG, or contract packaging experience. * Experience supporting automated liquid filling lines. * Six Sigma Green Belt or ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE). * Bilingual English/Spanish. **Physical Requirements** * Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the shift. * Ability to work in hot, cold, wet, and noisy manufacturing environments. * Ability to climb stairs and access elevated production platforms. * Ability to bend, stoop, kneel, and reach while inspecting materials and equipment. * Ability to lift up to 30 pounds. * Ability to wear required PPE. * Ability to distinguish colors and identify visual defects in bottles, caps, films, and labels. * Ability to travel occasionally to supplier facilities. **Why This Role Matters** At Tone Products, a packaging failure can stop a line. A leaking cap, an out\-of\-spec bottle, or a label that flags off costs us uptime and product. jobs.title: Senior Customer-Facing PHP Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** Transport Pro is a leading provider of web\-based logistics software. We are looking for a **Senior PHP Developer** who thrives at the intersection of deep technical problem\-solving and customer empathy. This is not a traditional behind\-the\-scenes engineering role, nor is it a simple helpdesk position. You will serve as the primary technical interface for our clients—translating real customer friction into robust software solutions. We need an experienced developer who genuinely cares about solving human problems through code, understands the business impact of production issues, and takes pride in making our clients feel heard, supported, and valued. **A Note on Technical Depth:** We require a genuine software engineer with foundational knowledge. We are looking for candidates who can read stack traces, write SQL queries by hand, debug environment issues, and write clean, scalable PHP from memory. While AI tools (like Claude or Cursor) are fine for secondary assistance, if you rely on generative AI or "vibe coding" to figure out basic logic or troubleshoot standard errors, this position will not be a fit. **Work Environment \& Travel:** This position is fully remote. Your core mandate will be handling high\-touch customer support requests, configuring custom client installations, and writing production\-ready system enhancements. Because logistics operates around the clock, while 24/7 work is not required, this is not a strict 9\-to\-5 desk job. You will be part of an on\-call rotation to respond to critical customer emergencies on nights and weekends when urgent production issues arise. Additionally, while the day\-to\-day role is remote, **occasional travel will be required** (e.g., key client visits, high\-touch onboarding, or company offsites). Candidates must be willing and able to travel periodically as needed. **Responsibilities** * **Customer\-Centric Problem Solving:** Directly interact with clients to diagnose complex technical issues, provide empathetic communication, and deliver timely, high\-quality resolution to production support tickets. * **Full\-Stack Application Development:** Develop, refactor, and enhance server\-side applications using PHP, ensuring high performance, security, and maintainability. * **API \& System Integration:** Design and implement robust APIs (RESTful and SOAP) to facilitate seamless integrations between client environments and our core logistics platform. * **Software Architecture \& Design:** Participate in system design discussions, contributing to scalable software architecture and long\-term platform improvements. * **Clean Code \& Process Discipline:** Write readable, well\-tested, maintainable code following established engineering standards, SDLC processes, and version control (SVN). * **Testing \& Quality Assurance:** Perform hands\-on debugging and unit testing to ensure application stability across production and staging environments. * **Cloud \& OS Operations:** Manage and deploy services within Linux environments hosted on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). **Requirements** **Soft Skills \& Mindset** * **Empathy First:** Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey complex technical concepts calmly and clearly to non\-technical stakeholders. * **Owner's Mentality:** Deep accountability for customer success—you treat client emergencies with the urgency and care they deserve. * **Strong Diagnostic Instincts:** A methodical approach to troubleshooting that relies on fundamental knowledge, system logs, and code inspection rather than trial\-and\-error AI generation. * **Willingness to Travel:** Open to occasional travel (typically \< 10\-15%) for key client on\-site visits, training sessions, or internal team meetings. **Technical Capabilities** * **3\+ Years Senior PHP Experience:** Demonstrated expertise in modern PHP backend development within a production enterprise environment. * **Core Engineering Principles:** Deep proficiency in Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP), design patterns, data structures, and secure coding practices. * **Database Mastery:** Strong hands\-on experience with relational databases, specifically schema design, optimization, and complex query writing in **PostgreSQL**. * **Full Web Stack Proficiency:** Solid understanding of front\-end web technologies, including JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, jQuery, and JSON formats. * **API \& Integration Protocols:** Proven experience designing and consuming RESTful and SOAP web services. * **Infrastructure \& Linux:** Familiarity with Linux server administration, shell scripting, containerized workflows, or cloud infrastructure (GCP/AWS). **Why Join Us?** At Transport Pro, we believe that great software engineering starts with a passion for helping real people. If you take pride in building rock\-solid code while delivering an exceptional client experience, we would love to have you on our team. Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

The engineer will own solutions across the delivery lifecycle—from discovery and rapid prototyping through architecture, implementation, cloud deployment, production stabilization, and user adoption. · The successful candidate is comfortable entering complex enterprise environments, learning unfamiliar domains quickly, making pragmatic technical decisions, and delivering measurable outcomes with limited specification. This is not a coordination\-only architect, pure frontend role, pure backend role, or cloud/DevOps role. **Key Responsibilities** · Forward\-Deployed Engineering · Full\-Stack Application Development · Frontend Engineering — Angular · AWS and Cloud Engineering · DevOps, Quality, Security, and Operations **Required Qualifications** · Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. · Typically, 8\+ years of professional software\-engineering experience, including significant recent hands\-on full\-stack delivery. · Strong production experience with Angular, TypeScript, C\#, ASP.NET Core, and AWS. · Demonstrated ability to own complete features across frontend, backend, integration, cloud deployment, testing, and production support. · Recent experience with Angular 18\+ concepts, including standalone components, Signals, RxJS, reactive forms, routing, guards, and interceptors. · Strong TypeScript skills, including generics, type constraints, utility types, typed API contracts, and robust domain modeling. · Strong HTML/CSS/SCSS skills, including semantic markup, Flexbox, Grid, responsive design, and accessibility. · Strong C\#/.NET skills, including API design, dependency injection, middleware, asynchronous programming, authentication/authorization, testing, and production troubleshooting. · Hands\-on experience designing or operating AWS workloads—not merely consuming cloud\-hosted applications. · Experience with SQL and relational data modeling; exposure to NoSQL where appropriate. · Experience with CI/CD, Docker, automated testing, observability, and Infrastructure as Code. · Ability to work directly with business users, clarify ambiguous requirements, prototype rapidly, and communicate technical trade\-offs clearly. · Strong analytical, troubleshooting, ownership, and stakeholder\-management skills. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: At Trunk Tools, we’re the leading AI company revolutionizing construction, the second\-largest industry on earth. We recently raised a $40M Series B led by Insight Partners, bringing our total funding to $70M from top\-tier investors including Redpoint and Innovation Endeavors. This new round is fueling our next phase of growth as we scale AI agents across the jobsite. Our mission is to build the future of construction through intelligent automation. Despite being a $13\+ trillion industry, construction still runs largely on analog processes, we’re changing that by embedding AI directly into field operations. Founded by builders and technologists (Stanford, MIT), our team has delivered software used by over 140,000 field professionals, impacting millions of users and contributing to $10B\+ in built projects. Many of us come from the field ourselves, giving us a deep understanding of the industry’s unique challenges. After years of building the “brain” of construction, we’re now launching production\-ready AI agents, starting with intelligent document processing and Q\&A, and rapidly expanding into core operational workflows. Our team has doubled in the past year, and with 100\+ employees (50\+ engineers), we’re scaling fast and entering a period of hypergrowth. This is a rare opportunity to join at an inflection point. **About the role** ------------------ Forward Deployed Engineers are how Trunk Tools gets into the field. You'll embed directly with our general contractor customers, stand up Cortex and our agents inside their real projects, and own the work of turning a pilot into a result the customer can measure: submittal reviews cut from 54\.8 days to 14, a 20\-sheet bulletin reviewed in under 10 minutes instead of roughly 6 hours, RFIs answered before they're ever sent. This is an early\-career role built for engineers who want to write real code, sit with real builders on real jobsites, and watch their work land in weeks, not quarters. You'll learn both the construction domain and the craft of deployment under experienced Forward Deployed Engineers, and everything you pick up in the field will flow straight back into the product. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Deploy Cortex and the agents into live projects.** Connect a customer's document set, integrate with the systems they already run (Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud), and configure the agents around how their teams actually work. * **Create new custom agents for use on live projects.** Leverage the Trunk Tools platform to create new agents for specific customer use cases that can be built, deployed, and used within a project, and used by the customer organization on multiple projects. * **Own the data\-to\-outcome loop for your accounts.** Get a working, measurable result on the customer's own drawings, specs, and submittals, fast, so the value is undeniable. * **Sit with the builders.** Spend time on jobsites and in trailers with project engineers, assistant project managers, and superintendents to learn their workflow and drive real adoption, not just a login. * **Write production\-quality code.** Build the tooling that makes each deployment work, and make it hold up as something the platform can reuse rather than a one\-off. * **Feed the field back into the product.** Bring what you learn to Product and Engineering so Cortex and the knowledge graph get sharper with every deployment. * **Partner with the account team.** Work alongside the deal owner from first proof through expanding across the customer's portfolio. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 0 to 3 years of software engineering experience with strong computer\-science fundamentals. Recent graduates with substantial project or internship experience are encouraged to apply. * Working proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript, and comfort with APIs, data, and building integrations between systems. * Clear, direct communication and genuine comfort in front of customers. We hire engineer\-diplomats: people who can write code in the morning and earn a superintendent's trust in the afternoon. * Willingness to travel to jobsites and customer offices, and real comfort working in the field, hard hat included. * A bias to action. You ship, you watch what breaks, you fix it, and you pick up a new domain quickly. * Low ego and a builder's respect for the people doing the work. **Bonus points** ---------------- * Exposure to construction, architecture, or engineering, or genuine curiosity about how buildings get built. * Familiarity with data, machine learning, or retrieval systems. * Prior customer\-facing, deployment, or forward\-deployed work. * Hands\-on experience with Procore or Autodesk Construction Cloud. **How we work** --------------- We live by three values, and this role touches all of them: * **Low Ego** \- we learn what construction teams need directly from them, on the jobsite. This job is that value made literal. * **No BS** \- we don't over\-promise AI. Every result you deliver should tie to time saved, cost reduced, or work won, and it should be real. * **High Output** \- we ship what we said we'd ship, when we said we'd ship it. **What we offer** A close\-knit and collaborative early\-stage startup environment where every voice is heard and every opinion matters Competitive salary and stock option equity packages 4 Medical Plans to choose from including 100% covered option. Plus Dental and Vision Insurance! Learning \& Growth stipend Flexible long\-term work options (remote and hybrid) Free lunch provided in the office in NYC \& Austin \- you’ll never go hungry with us! Unlimited PTO; We truly believe in work\-life balance and that hard work should be balanced with time for rest and rejuvenation IRL / In\-Person retreats throughout the year ***Please note:*** *All official communication from Trunk Tools will come from an email address ending in* ***@******trunk.tools****. If you receive outreach from any other domain, please disregard it or report it to us.* *At Trunk Tools, we’re working hard to build a more productive and safer environment within the construction industry, and we strive to live by these same values here at Trunk Tools HQ. As an equal\-opportunity employer, we are committed to building an inclusive environment where you can be you. We work hard to evaluate all employees and job applicants consistently, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected class.* Compensation Range: $128,700 \- $209,000

More than 50,000 students are enrolled at one of eight institutions, including the research campus in Columbia and comprehensive four\-year universities in Aiken, Upstate and Beaufort. In addition, our Palmetto College campuses in Salkehatchie, Union, Lancaster and Sumter enable students to earn associate or bachelor’s degrees through a combination of in\-person, online or blended learning. All of our system institutions place strong emphasis on service — helping to build healthier, more educated communities in South Carolina and beyond. **Veterans' Preference Statement** The University of South Carolina is committed to equal opportunity and proudly values the skills and experience military veterans bring to our workforce. Across South Carolina, we are making veterans a priority for employment and recognize their vital contributions to our state and our communities. Benefits for FTE Positions The University of South Carolina (USC), through the State of SC and Public Employee Benefit Authority (PEBA), offers employees a valuable benefits package, including health and life insurance, generous paid leave and retirement programs. To learn more about USC benefits, access the "Working at USC" section on the Applicant Portal at https://uscjobs.sc.edu. Research Grant or Time\-limited positions may be eligible for all, some, or no benefits, based on the grant or project funding. Position Description **Advertised Job Summary** Under the supervision of the Assistant Director of Engineering Support, the Mechanical Engineer leads in\-house mechanical engineering design efforts and performs technical management for HVAC, hydronic, steam, and plumbing infrastructure projects across the University of South Carolina\-Columbia Campus. This role is responsible for executing high\-quality in\-house mechanical designs, leading multi\-disciplinary teams, and conducting thorough technical reviews of campus central energy plants, chilled water modeling, steam distribution, and building mechanical systems. The Mechanical Engineer coordinates mechanical designs across delivery methods to ensure overall compatibility with site and building plans, performs field investigations to refine project scopes, and exercises delegated AHJ technical review and approval authority for campus mechanical installations, energy efficiency renewals, and code compliance. **Job Related Minimum Required Education and Experience** * Requires a bachelor’s degree in a job related field and 3 or more years of job related experience, which may be substituted by an equivalent combination of job related certification, training, education, and/or experience. **Required Certification, Licensure/Other Credentials** * Driver’s license required. **Preferred Qualifications** * Active Registered Professional Engineer (PE) license in the State of South Carolina (or ability to obtain via reciprocity within 6 months of hire). **Knowledge/Skills/Abilities** * Deep knowledge of the International Mechanical Code (IMC), International Plumbing Code (IPC), ASHRAE standards (including 90\.1 and 62\.1\), NFPA standards, South Carolina Consolidated Procurement Code, and Office of State Engineer (OSE) guidelines. * Authority and capability to serve as a technical AHJ reviewer for campus mechanical permit approvals, field inspections, code interpretations, and system variances. Proficiency in CAD and BIM software (AutoCAD, Revit) and mechanical system modeling/energy analysis tools (e.g., Trane TRACE, Carrier HAP, pipe flow/hydronic modeling). * Skilled in leading multi\-disciplinary in\-house design teams and coordinating across architectural, electrical, structural, and civil disciplines. Strong project management, analytical, field\-investigation, and clear technical communication skills. Job Duties **Job Duty** Execute in\-house mechanical engineering design work products and services   all aspects of mechanical engineering design for a wide variety of campus infrastructure projects, including HVAC systems, central chilled water, steam distribution, plumbing, and building automation controls. **Essential Function** Yes **Percentage of Time** 30 **Job Duty** Serve as a designated Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) representative for mechanical engineering matters. jobs.title: Engineering Project Management
jobs.description: **Engineering Project Management** Direct/Manage/Supervise the activities of engineering project managers and associated staff. Oversee and coordinate multiple related engineering projects. Provide guidance to project managers on proposal analysis/proposal development, workload planning, project schedules, and cost/budget to ensure projects align with program capabilities and the overarching business objectives. Address and resolve escalated issues from project stakeholders, including engineers, clients, or regulatory agencies. May be responsible for overall program profit and loss (P\&L) statement. Requires a bachelor’s degree in engineering, mathematics, or related field. **Learn more about the great benefits of working for University of Utah: benefits.utah.edu** **The department may choose to hire at any of the below job levels and associated pay rates based on their business need and budget.** **Responsibilities** The University of Utah seeks a full\-time Project Manager to support a newly funded NSF Programmable Cloud Laboratory (PCL) Test Bed Node, a distributed research facility providing remote, programmable access to scientific instruments through open APIs and AI\-assisted automated workflows. Reporting to the PI/Node Director and serving on the Node Management Team alongside the Operations/User Support, Data \& AI, and Research Security/Biosafety leads, the Project Manager will hold primary responsibility for managing the project’s budget, schedule, and scope. Core duties include developing and maintaining the Project Implementation Plan and the living Strategic Implementation Plan; tracking progress against the program’s milestone gates (Alpha at 12 months, Beta at 18 months, Robust User Service at 24 months, and a Post\-Award Continued Operation plan at 48 months); maintaining the Instrument Inventory Table in compliance with 2 CFR 200\.313; preparing and submitting quarterly and annual reports through Research.gov; coordinating NSF site visits, coordination videoconferences, and cross\-node standards working groups; organizing Recruitment and On\-Boarding Workshops and the annual in\-person PCL PI meeting; monitoring risks and compliance obligations spanning research security, AI safety, biosafety, participant support costs, and Build America Buy America requirements; and collecting and reporting user satisfaction metrics. PMP certification or equivalent qualification is required, along with demonstrated experience managing complex, multi\-stakeholder technical projects, preferably in a federally funded research or shared instrumentation facility environment. Strong written communication, budget management, and cross\-institutional coordination skills are essential. **Minimum Qualifications** **EQUIVALENCY****STATEMENT****:** 1 year of higher education can be substituted for 1 year of directly related work experience (Example: bachelor’s degree \= 4 years of directly related work experience). **Department may hire employee at one of the following job levels:** **Senior Supervisor, Engineering Project Management:** Requires a bachelor’s (or equivalency) \+ 4 years or a master’s (or equivalency) \+ 2 years of directly related work experience. **Preferences** **PMP** **(Project Management Professional)** from PMI, or an equivalent qualification that may include * PgMP or PMI\-ACP (also PMI) * PRINCE2 Practitioner * IPMA Level C or B certification * CAPM plus substantial documented project management experience **Type** Benefited Staff **Special Instructions Summary** **Additional Information** The University is a participating employer with Utah Retirement Systems (“URS”). jobs.description: **Network Infrastructure Engineer** =================================== **Position Title:** Network Infrastructure Engineer **Career Level:** SME **Number of Positions:** 3 **Education:** High School **Location:** Clinton, Mississippi **Work Arrangement:** 100% Onsite **Contract Duration:** Oct, 2026 – March 31, 2027 **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM **Hours:** 40 hours/week **Overtime:** Occasional **Travel:** Occasional, in\-state only **Position Summary** -------------------- We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Network Infrastructure Engineer to support and advance a large\-scale enterprise networking environment. The Network Infrastructure Engineer will be responsible for designing, deploying, operating, securing, and troubleshooting enterprise data center and campus network infrastructure. The position will focus heavily on Cisco ACI, Cisco Nexus, Cisco Catalyst, Software\-Defined Access (SDA), Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE), network observability platforms, and enterprise network security. The engineer will work closely with infrastructure and technology teams to ensure network services remain reliable, scalable, secure, and aligned with modernization initiatives. This is a hands\-on engineering position requiring advanced technical expertise and the ability to support mission\-critical environments. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Cisco ACI \& Data Center Networking** * Design, implement, and maintain Cisco Nexus platforms operating in ACI mode. * Configure and administer ACI VRFs, Bridge Domains, EPGs/ESGs, L3Outs, contracts, and fabric policies. * Integrate ACI with Red Hat OpenShift VMM and Isovalent/Cilium. * Configure and optimize RoCEv2 for high\-performance and low\-latency workloads. * Troubleshoot ACI fabric health, faults, endpoint learning, contracts, and multi\-tenant segmentation. * Maintain network architecture documentation, standards, diagrams, and operational procedures. ### **Cisco Catalyst \& SDA** * Deploy and support Cisco Catalyst platforms in enterprise campus environments. * Design and maintain Cisco Software\-Defined Access (SDA) architectures. * Support SDA Wired Fabric and Fabric\-Enabled Wireless. * Manage SDA underlay and overlay networks, policy mapping, authentication integrations, and assurance operations. * Collaborate with wireless engineering teams to optimize network coverage, performance, and policy enforcement. ### **Identity \& Network Security** * Configure and administer Cisco ISE. * Manage TACACS\+, authentication and authorization policy sets, and endpoint profiling. * Integrate Cyber Vision intelligence into device profiling, segmentation, and access\-control workflows. * Support Zero Trust networking through identity\-centric segmentation and policy integration across ACI and SDA. ### **Network Visibility \& Observability** * Deploy and manage ThousandEyes for end\-to\-end visibility, routing analysis, and performance monitoring. * Support Cisco Cyber Vision for OT/IoT asset visibility, classification, and behavioral analysis. * Manage DNA Spaces for location analytics, telemetry, device behavior, and wireless intelligence. * Analyze data from observability platforms and communicate meaningful findings to technical stakeholders and leadership. ### **Core Network Engineering** * Troubleshoot complex Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking issues. * Work extensively with VLANs, OSPF, BGP, STP, multicast, TCP/IP, routing, switching, and QoS. * Design and implement Palo Alto Networks security solutions. * Create and maintain network architecture diagrams, standards, runbooks, and asset inventories. * Support infrastructure modernization, platform upgrades, procurement activities, and enterprise technology initiatives. * Perform other related duties as assigned. **Required Skills \& Experience** --------------------------------- * **Minimum 15 years of experience working with Cisco networking technologies.** * Production experience with Cisco ACI. * Strong knowledge of ACI VRF, BD, EPG, ESG, L3Out, and contracts. * Experience integrating ACI with OpenShift VMM and Cilium/Isovalent. * Strong Cisco Catalyst and SDA experience. * Experience administering Cisco ISE, including TACACS\+ and policy\-set\-based NAC. * Experience with ThousandEyes, Cyber Vision, DNA Spaces, or comparable observability platforms. * Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, QoS, and network security. * Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. * Ability to create network diagrams, technical documentation, and architectural artifacts. * Excellent communication skills and ability to work in mission\-critical enterprise environments. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * CCNP Data Center, CCNP Enterprise, CCIE, or equivalent experience. * Experience with container networking and virtualization integrations. * Knowledge of NIST frameworks and cybersecurity requirements. * Experience with Python, Ansible, REST APIs, or other network automation technologies. * Experience working in state government or large enterprise environments. * PCCSA certification. * PCNSA certification. * Experience with Palo Alto NGFW configuration, security profiles, NAT, App\-ID, URL filtering, and WildFire.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next\-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. **What you will do** -------------------- This role partners directly with functional leaders in Finance, Credit, Operations, Legal, and HR to translate business needs into clear technical requirements; collaborates closely with data engineering to design or acquire the right datasets; and leads the model‑to‑product lifecycle with strong attention to Responsible AI and model governance. In addition to delivering high‑impact solutions tied to VFS priorities, the role mentors and guides data scientists, setting technical direction and quality standards while building the foundations for a future formal leadership path.
